- starting in Spring Framework 7.1, `ForwardedHeaderFilter` (Spring MVC) and `ForwardedHeaderTransformer` (WebFlux) each require a boolean argument whether to use the standard "Forwarded" header or the "X-Forwarded" alternative headers. A separate property enables use of "X-Forwarded-Prefix" if needed. The default constructor with the existing behaviour of checking both types of headers is still available but deprecated and marked for removal. The new constructor makes forwarded header processing more deterministic and aligned with what is expected from the proxy. Please, see the updated [Security Considerations](https://docs.spring.io/spring-framework/reference/7.1-SNAPSHOT/web/webmvc/filters.html#filters-forwarded-headers-security) section, as well as related changes in Spring Boot https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/issues/51030. - In Spring Framework 7.0.9, `ForwardedHeaderFilter` (Spring MVC) and `ForwardedHeaderTransformer` (WebFlux) each provide a boolean constructor argument whether to use the standard "Forwarded" header or the "X-Forwarded" alternative headers. A separate property turns on and off use of "X-Forwarded-Prefix". While the default constructor preserves the existing behavior, we recommend to use the new constructor to explicitly specify which forwarded headers to use to make the processing more deterministic and aligned with what is expected from the proxy. Please, see the updated [Security Considerations](https://docs.spring.io/spring-framework/reference/7.0.9-SNAPSHOT/web/webmvc/filters.html#filters-forwarded-headers-security) section for details. In 7.1 with #37072 the default constructor is deprecated and marked for removal. [#37090](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/37090)
- In Spring Framework 7.0.9, `SimpleEvaluationContext` no longer supports expression compilation by default, regardless of the compiler mode configured via `SpelParserConfiguration` or the `spring.expression.compiler.mode` system property or Spring property. Applications that intentionally use `SimpleEvaluationContext` with trusted expressions and require compilation for performance reasons can opt in by calling `withCompilationSupported()` on the `SimpleEvaluationContext` builder. Care should be taken when opting in to compilation, as doing so removes the safety guards applied during interpreted evaluation. [#37035](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/37035)

:star: New Features

- Improve `SpringValidatorAdapter` and `MethodValidationAdapter` performance [#36621](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36621)

- Handle blank Accept-Language header in AcceptHeaderLocaleResolver [#36513](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36513)
- Make AbstractStreamingClientHttpRequest and AbstractBufferingClientHttpRequest public [#36501](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36501)
- MySQL Error 149 (Galera/WSREP conflict) not translated to ConcurrencyFailureException in Spring JDBC/ORM [#36499](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36499)

- Flushing-related regression in `SseServerResponse` [#36537](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36537)
- LazyConnectionDataSourceProxy does not pass on holdability to target Connection [#36528](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36528)
- `AnnotationBeanNameGenerator` fails when an annotation references a non-existent class [#36524](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36524)
- Perserve default API version in RestClientAdapter [#36514](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36514)
- Inconsistent codings resolution in resource resolvers [#36507](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36507)
- `DefaultJmsListenerContainer` may hang in an endless loop in `doShutdown` [#36506](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36506)
- Query not hidden in DefaultClientResponse checkpoint [#36502](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36502)
- RestClient closes stream for ResponseEntity<InputStream> responses [#36492](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36492)
- IllegalStateException when using websocket handshake headers with Tomcat [#36486](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36486)

## :star: New Features

- Leverage `ResourceHandlerUtils` in `ScriptTemplateView` [#36458](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36458)

- Support application-wide defaultHtmlEscape setting in WebFlux RequestContext [#36400](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36400)
- Support `Predicate<RequestPath>>` in path API version resolver [#36398](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36398)
- Avoid duplicate flushes in HttpMessageConverter implementations [#36383](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36383)
- Add support for non-flushing OutputStream to StreamUtils [#36382](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36382)
- Make it easier to get InputStream from RestClient [#36380](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36380)

- Improve ResourceHttpMessageConverter target type support [#36368](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36368)
- org.springframework.test.web.servlet.assertj.AbstractHttpServletResponseAssert#headers case sensitivity [#36349](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36349)
- Allow registering serialized lambda metadata through RuntimeHints [#36339](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36339)
- Refactor calculateHashCode in RequestMappingInfo [#36325](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36325)

/v7.0.4","zipball_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/spring-projects/spring-framework/zipball/v7.0.4","body":"## :star: New Features

- Cache method annotations in `MethodParameter` and `AnnotatedMethod` [#36307](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36307)
- Consistently support `@Lazy` as a meta-annotation at arbitrary depths [#36306](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36306)
- Consistently support `@Validated` as a meta-annotation at arbitrary depths [#36305](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36305)
- Let developers disable default registrations in HttpMessageConverters [#36303](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36303)
- Log which HandlerInterceptor threw the exception [#36281](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36281)
- Improve performance of hashcode calculations for request mappings [#36279](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36279)
- Improve performance of HandlerMethod bean lookup [#36278](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36278)
- Improve performance of version mapping [#36276](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36276)
- Improve performance of single pattern request mappings [#36275](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36275)
- Improve performance of validation groups determination [#36274](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36274)
- Add `setPackagesToScan` configuration method to `LocalEntityManagerFactoryBean` [#36270](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36270)
- Remove outdated GraalVM substitution [#36257](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36257)
- Introduce `beforeRetry` callback with `RetryState` argument [#36245](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36245)
- Optimize NamedParameterUtils#buildValueArray by lazily fetching SqlParameter [#36230](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36230)
- Allow customization of the `ProxyFactory` in `HttpServiceProxyFactory` used to create HTTP service proxies [#36225](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36225)
- Consistently close streams through try-with-resources in FileCopyUtils [#36223](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36223)
- Use Java Files utilities in FileCopyUtils [#36221](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36221)
- SqlBinaryValue and SqlCharacterValue should support InputStream content with undetermined length [#36219](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36219)
- Support JtaTransactionManager and SpringBeanContainer configuration on HibernateJpaVendorAdapter [#36216](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36216)
- Add TaskCallback/Callable/Runnable wrapper for retryable tasks [#36208](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36208)
- Refine YamlProcessor to allow different empty values [#36207](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36207)
- Anticipate fixing Kotlin 2.3 compilation warning [#36203](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36203)
- Allow YAML processors to create a flattened map with nulls included [#36197](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36197)
- Use Reader.transferTo in FileCopyUtils [#36196](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36196)
- `DataBufferUtils.write()` with NettyDataBuffer on JDK 25 hangs indefinitely [#36184](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36184)
- Make SendToMethodReturnValueHandler and SubscriptionMethodReturnValueHandler customizable, to allow for pass-through of message headers [#36179](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36179)
- Introduce `RestClient.ResponseSpec#requiredBody` [#36173](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36173)
- Make scope fully configurable in BeanRegistry/BeanRegistrar [#36171](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36171)
- ConcurrencyThrottleSupport and thread interruption [#36167](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36167)
- Add overloaded sendAndReceive methods to JmsTemplate to use explicit response queue [#36162](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36162)
- WebClient (Reactor) attributes on Netty channel do not clear after connection release [#36158](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36158)
- Support HttpEntity on ContentRequestMatchers.multipartData [#36154](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36154)
- Reintroduce WebLogicJtaTransactionManager in Spring Framework 6.2.x [#36151](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36151)
- Back-off for `DefaultMessageListenerContainer` is not applied consistently in case of listener setup failure [#36143](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36143)
- Early support for JPA 4.0 EntityAgent (autowiring a shared proxy) [#36025](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36025)
- Early compatibility with JPA 4.0 and Hibernate ORM 8.0 [#35705](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35705)

/api.github.com/repos/spring-projects/spring-framework/zipball/v7.0.3","body":"## :warning: Attention Required

- Introduce Spring property to disable context pausing for tests [#36117](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36117)
- Avoid unnecessary pausing of application contexts in the TestContext framework [#36044](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36044)

## :star: New Features

- DisconnectedClientHelper should detect presence of RestClientException and WebClientException separately [#36141](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36141)
- Deprecate `PagedListHolder` and `PropertyComparator` for removal [#36139](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36139)
- Add DataAccessException and MessagingException to the excluded outermost exceptions in DisconnectedClientHelper [#36134](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36134)
- Support property placeholders in HTTP service registry [#36126](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36126)
- Retain original requested bean class for SpringContainedBean [#36116](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36116)
- Add task rejection support to SyncTaskExecutor's concurrency throttle [#36114](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36114)
- Precompute `PropertyDescriptor` array in `SimpleBeanInfoFactory` [#36112](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36112)
- Add option for `@ConcurrencyLimit` to throw rejection exception [#36109](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36109)
- Support HttpComponents 5.6 [#36100](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36100)
- Fix double encoding in `DefaultApiVersionInserter` [#36097](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36097)
- Optimize single-char wildcard path matching performance [#36095](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36095)
- Allow WebFlux ApiVersionResolver to return a Mono [#36084](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36084)
- Configure HttpMessageConverters as a list [#36083](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36083)
- HTTP Interface with an `@RequestBody Object` method parameter should use class of actual value [#36078](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36078)
- Consistently declare `@Nullable` on  parameter in `equals()` implementations [#36075](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36075)
- Support listener registration for `@Transactional` triggered method rollbacks [#36073](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36073)
- Introduce generalized `MethodFailureEvent` for use in `EventPublicationInterceptor` [#36072](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36072)
- Avoid duplicate flushes in StringHttpMessageConverter [#36065](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36065)
- When no API version is provided, static resources fail to load [#36059](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36059)
- When no API version is provided, `/error` requests also fail. [#36058](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36058)
- Declare `TaskCallback` return value as potentially nullable [#36057](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36057)
- Fix case-insensitive semantics for LinkedCaseInsensitiveMap entrySet [#36056](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36056)
- Update to NullAway 0.12.15 and fix new warnings [#36054](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36054)
- Provide alternative to `execute(Retryable)` which avoids `RetryException` in favor of rethrowing the last original `RuntimeException` [#36052](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36052)
- Simplify TransactionalOperator.executeAndAwait by removing Optional [#36039](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36039)
- Deprecated MockMvcClientHttpRequestFactory is required for tests with HTTP service interface proxy [#35989](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35989)
- Introduce Jackson XML codecs [#35752](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35752)
- Support listener registration for `@Retryable` triggered retry executions [#35382](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35382)

## :lady_beetle: Bug Fixes

- Fix `SmartFactoryBean` type matching for `ResolvableType.NONE` [#36123](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36123)
- `AbstractMessageSendingTemplate` ignores headers in `convertAndSend()` variant [#36120](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36120)
- `JmsClient.sendAndReceive()` fails if headers are included [#36118](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36118)
- `PropertyDescriptorUtils` does not reliably resolve overloaded write methods [#36113](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36113)
- Fix context class resolution for nested types in `AbstractJacksonHttpMessageConverter` [#36111](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36111)
- `DefaultApiVersionInserter` encodes already encoded URI [#36080](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36080)
- ConverterFactory nullness mismatch with Converter [#36063](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36063)
- WiretapConnector leaks data buffers when response body not consumed [#36050](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36050)
- CompilationException should not use -1 for line or column numbers when they are unknown [#36041](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36041)
- org.springframework.core.test.tools.TestCompiler.Errors should handle case where warnings are turned into errors [#36037](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36037)
- UriComponentsBuilder loses the fragment when it consists of only a single character [#36029](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36029)
- Parameter names of the handler method are null in HandlerInterceptor::preHandle during first invocation of an endpoint [#36024](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36024)
- `PropertyDescriptorUtils` does not reliably resolve read/write methods in type hierarchies with generics [#36019](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36019)
- Illegal reflection use against Hibernate Validator 9 on module path [#36012](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36012)

- Clarify unversioned handler matching precedence [#36125](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36125)
- Clarify meaning of maxAttempts in FixedBackOff vs. maxRetries in RetryPolicy [#36119](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36119)

- Modernize the DispatcherServlet Locale documentation [#36099](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36099)
- Fix Kotlin example in `Multipart Content` [#36094](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36094)
- Remove `@EnableWebFlux` from documentation code snippets [#36091](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36091)
- Fix Kotlin example in `CORS` and `Functional Endpoints` references [#36089](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36089)
- Extract remaining WebMVC configuration snippets [#36088](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36088)
- Remove the "Other Web Frameworks" documentation [#36086](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36086)
- Fix reference links in `Configuration` page [#36079](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36079)
- Document HttpHeaders#toSingleValueMap() case-sensitive behavior [#36070](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36070)
- Correct `encode` Javadoc for `UriComponents` and `UriComponentsBuilder` [#36040](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36040)
- Fix typos and grammar [#36022](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36022)
- Custom `@ExceptionHandler` silently ignored when `spring.mvc.problemdetails.enabled=true` without `@Order` [#35982](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35982)
- Document how to discard response body with WebTestClient [#35953](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35953)
- Modernize the view technologies section [#35450](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35450)
- Remove JavaScript/Kotlin from ScriptEngine documentation [#27919](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27919)

## :hammer: Dependency Upgrades

- Upgrade to Micrometer 1.16.2 [#36145](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36145)

all/v7.0.2","zipball_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/spring-projects/spring-framework/zipball/v7.0.2","body":"## :star: New Features

- Avoid unnecessary list creation and processing in `AbstractTestContextBootstrapper` [#35995](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35995)
- `AbstractTestContextBootstrapper` should resolve `ContextLoader` only once [#35994](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35994)
- Log `RetryException` for `@Retryable` methods [#35983](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35983)
- Consistently stop already started `Lifecycle` beans on cancelled refresh [#35964](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35964)
- Support timeouts in `@Retryable` and `RetryPolicy` [#35963](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35963)
- Use `==` instead of `instanceof` for primitive array type checks [#35962](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35962)
- Introduce `MultiValueMapCollector` for use with streams [#35958](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/35958)
- Avoid package cycle caused by use of UriComponentsBuilder in ServletServerHttpRequest [#35952](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35952)
- Target type in Converter interface should be `@Nullable` [#35947](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35947)
- Provide access to attempt count in `RetryListener` as well as callbacks for the initial attempt [#35940](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35940)
- DefaultHandshakeHandler should not log client faults on error level [#35930](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35930)
- Log warning when meta-annotation is ignored due to types not present in classpath [#35927](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35927)
- Revise `ApplicationContext#getId()` nullability to non-null [#35925](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35925)
- Use concurrent set behind reactive `TransactionSynchronizationManager#registerSynchronization` [#35921](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35921)
- Refine `AbstractKotlinSerializationHttpMessageConverter#canWrite` [#35920](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35920)
- Register bean dependency for `Optional` injection point as well [#35919](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35919)
- Change `canRead`/`canWrite` overrides to `Class` ones in `AbstractSmartHttpMessageConverter` [#35916](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35916)
- Do not make HttpHeaders read-only in HttpEntity [#35888](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35888)
- Add WebFlux SSE support with GSON [#35884](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35884)
- Different ReactorNettyWebSocketSession call getId()  may return the same value [#35883](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35883)
- Refine nullability of `Assert#noNullElements` [#35868](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/35868)
- Allow configuring default maxIdleTime on InMemoryWebSessionStore. [#35866](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/35866)
- Refine `BindingReflectionHintsRegistrar` with `ObjectToObjectConverter` hints [#35847](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35847)
- Add `resetCaches()` method to general CacheManager interface [#35845](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35845)
- Enhance handleTypeMismatch error message in ResponseEntityExceptionHandler [#35837](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35837)
- Add support for package-private `BeanRegistrar` in Spring AOT generated code [#35803](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35803)
- Use ExtendedServletRequestDataBinder/ExtendedWebExchangeDataBinder for functional request binding [#35800](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35800)
- Expose Collection<ModelAndView> on FragmentsRendering to facilitate Unit Tests [#35775](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35775)
- Improve i18n-support for NoResourceFoundException [#35758](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/35758)
- Cache resolved singleton beans in injected `Provider` instance [#35373](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35373)

## :lady_beetle: Bug Fixes

- `ContextConfigurationAttributes(Class)` constructor incorrectly sets `inheritLocations` to `false` [#36000](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36000)
- NullPointerException thrown from JdkClientHttpRequestFactory for null request header value [#35996](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35996)
- State inconsistency in LazyConnectionDataSourceProxy when connection settings fail [#35980](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35980)
- SubscriberInputStream#resume misuses parked thread reference [#35978](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/35978)
- Shared EntityManager returned by AbstractEntityManagerFactoryBean cannot be advised by AspectJ interceptor [#35974](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35974)

- ServerRequestObservationContext(s) miss Propagator.Getter method implementation [#35965](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35965)

- DefaultMessageListenerContainer does not clear Session and MessageConsumer for paused invokers [#35932](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35932)
- Tighten cacheable decision behind `@Lazy` injection point [#35917](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35917)
- AOT-generated bean definition does not consider name of `RuntimeBeanReference` using name and type [#35913](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35913)
- Accidental fallback match for Collection-type beans due to `@Bean`-level qualifier annotation [#35908](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35908)
- `SingletonSupplier` should be defensive against `singletonInstance`/`initialized` visibility mismatch [#35905](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35905)
- SortedResourcesFactoryBean does not accept non-existent resources anymore [#35895](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35895)
- Support reading unresolvable types in `AbstractJacksonHttpMessageConverter` [#35889](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35889)
- Refine Kotlin Serialization codec type checks [#35885](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35885)
- UrlHandlerFilter also removes query parameters and fragment when using HTTP redirect [#35873](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35873)
- Fix handling of `ServerSentEvent` with Jackson encoder [#35872](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35872)
- `@EnableResilientMethods` does not participate in globally enforced target class proxying [#35863](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35863)
- RestTestClient can leak HTTP connections when no body expectations are performed [#35784](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35784)
- Use provided ReactiveAdapterRegistry in BindingContext constructor [#35771](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/35771)
- PathMatchingResourcePatternResolver fails with URI in JAR manifest Class-Path entries [#35682](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35682)

- Clarify JMS `sessionTransacted` flag for local versus global transaction [#35897](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35897)
- Reference docs should not use obsolete "junit5" links [#35892](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35892)

## :star: New Features

- Make SessionHolder publicly accessible for external resource management [#35799](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35799)
- RouterFunctions Builders do not support ServerResponse subtypes [#35791](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35791)
- Configure Jackson CBOR codecs by default if present [#35787](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35787)
- Rename `maxAttempts` to `maxRetries` in `@Retryable` and `RetryPolicy` [#35772](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35772)
- Prevent Kotlin Serialization side effects [#35761](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35761)
- Add default API version to the list of supported versions [#35755](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35755)
- Improve user check in TransportHandlingSockJsService [#35753](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35753)
- Update ApiVersionDeprecationHandler to provide access to handler [#35750](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35750)
- Use dedicated classes for ApiVersionResolver implementations [#35747](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35747)
- Provide AOT support for `@Nested` classes in a `@ParameterizedClass` [#35744](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35744)
- AssertJ support for WebTestClient [#35737](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35737)
- Reject attempt to use `@MockitoSpyBean` with a scoped proxy [#35722](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35722)
- Provide a way to supply the client builder for an HttpServiceGroup [#35707](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35707)
- Review HttpMessageConverters.Builder to improve readability of code using the API [#35704](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35704)
- Configure custom Kotlin Serialization converter on HttpMessageConverters [#35733](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35733)

## :lady_beetle: Bug Fixes

- Missing support for UnprocessableContent in WebClientResponseException.create(HttpStatusCode, ..) methods [#35802](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35802)
- Relax media type checks in HttpMessageConverters [#35801](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35801)
- Fix `HttpHeaders` and `WebSocketHttpHeaders` interop issues [#35792](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35792)
- `@ConcurrencyLimit` weird behavior when combined with `@Async` and `@Transactional` [#35788](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35788)
- buildSrc:test failing on JDKs before JDK 25 [#35777](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35777)
- Add jar validation and fix multi-release jar [#35768](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/35768)
- Upgrade to JUnit 6.0.1 and prevent AOT test scanning failure for JUnit 4 tests [#35740](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35740)
- Fix port handling in `HtmlUnitRequestBuilder` [#35709](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35709)
- RestTestClient.mutate() should not have side effects [#35698](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/35698)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Document workaround for `@PersistenceContext` and `@PersistenceUnit` in test classes in AOT [#31442](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31442)

- Upgrade to Reactor 2025.0.0 [#35779](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35779)

ork/tarball/v6.2.13","zipball_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/spring-projects/spring-framework/zipball/v6.2.13","body":"## - Support response encoding in `select` and `options` JSP form tags [#35783](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35783)
- Preserve Connection readOnly state for DataSource with defaultReadOnly configuration [#35743](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35743)

## :lady_beetle: Bug Fixes

- `ConcurrentReferenceHashMap` misses dedicated `computeIfAbsent`, `computeIfPresent`, `compute`, `merge` implementations [#35794](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35794)
- Avoid unnecessary bridge method resolution around getMostSpecificMethod [#35780](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35780)
- Fix multi-release JAR issue with VirtualThreadDelegate [#35773](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35773)
- ContentNegotiationManager not finding media type when request includes quality parameter [#35754](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35754)
- Race condition in BufferingClientHttpResponseWrapper.getBody() [#35745](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35745)
- Deprecate setConnectTimeout on HttpComponentsClientHttpRequestFactory [#35748](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35748)
- Fix PathMatchingResourcePatternResolver to handle absolute paths in JAR manifests [#35732](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/35732)
- BeanDefinitionBuilder.addAutowiredProperty causes error during AOT processing [#35731](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35731)
- Improve `HttpServiceMethod` support for Kotlin suspending functions returning `Flow` [#35718](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/35718)

- Remove deprecation on `CandidateComponentsIndex` and `CandidateComponentsIndexLoader` [#35472](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35472)
- Processing response with no Content-Length header and no body raises EOFException [#35361](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35361)

## :lady_beetle: Bug Fixes

- DefaultListableBeanFactory::getBeanNamesForType does not always return all bean names [#35634](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35634)

- Release data buffer in AbstractCharSequenceDecoder even when String creation fails [#35625](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/35625)
- PathMatchingResourcePatternResolver is not able to resolve file in SpringBoot Packaged JAR [#35617](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35617)
- Prevent NoClassDefFoundError when Jetty Reactive HttpClient is not available [#35608](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/35608)
- Performance regression with Property Placeholder Resolution [#35594](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35594)
- Retain order of `produces` media types in `@ExceptionHandler` [#35587](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/35587)
- Nested transaction support via savepoints is broken in HSQLDB database [#35564](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35564)
- SpEL expression parser uses more CPU after upgrade to 6.2.9 [#35556](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35556)
- Thread race during FactoryBean instantiations starting with 6.2 due to lenient locks [#35545](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35545)
- Update parsed path handling in UrlHandlerFilter [#35538](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35538)
- ResourceHttpMessageWriter.write has unexpected error handling for invalid range requests (offset > content length) [#35536](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35536)
- `AbstractTestNGSpringContextTests` is not thread-safe regarding tracked exceptions [#35528](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35528)
- UrlHandlerFilter breaks RequestDispatcher.forward() on Tomcat [#35509](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35509)
- AbstractMockHttpServletRequestBuilder#buildRequest is not idempotent [#35493](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/35493)
- Add support for `JvmDefault` (default in Kotlin 2.2.20+) [#35487](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35487)
- InstanceSupplierCodeGenerator fails to detect deprecated type on package private factory method [#35486](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35486)
- Fix synchronization in ResponseBodyEmitter [#35466](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35466)
- useCaches option in PathMatchingResourcePatternResolver not applied in special case [#35465](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/35465)
- Deadlock during context initialization due to EntityManager lock [#35398](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35398)

:star: New Features

- Align `JpaTransactionManager` default for `nestedTransactionAllowed` flag [#35457](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35457)
- Introduce `onRetryPolicyInterruption()` callback in `RetryListener` [#35442](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35442)
- Add DataFieldMaxValueIncrementer for SQLite [#35440](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35440)
- Consistent support for non-default NIO.2 FileSystems [#35435](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35435)
- Include exceptions for previous attempts in `RetryException` thrown for an `InterruptedException` [#35434](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35434)
- Include current exception in log message for failed retry attempt [#35433](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35433)
- Remove HttpServiceClient Annotation Support [#35431](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35431)
- Deprecate `put(MergedContextConfiguration, ApplicationContext)` in `ContextCache` [#35415](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35415)
- ServerSentEventHttpMessageReader should process empty data lines [#35412](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35412)
- Make it possible to stream "application/grpc" in Spring MVC via Flux<T> [#35401](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35401)
- Add createException method to ConvertibleClientHttpResponse in RestClient [#35391](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35391)
- Consider throwing an error if `setVersionRequired` and `setDefaultVersion` are called on `ApiVersionConfigurer` [#35387](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35387)
- Accept `maxAttempts(0)` in `RetryPolicy` builder [#35362](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35362)
- Generate consistent validation error messages in `RetryPolicy` [#35355](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35355)
- Drop support for Undertow as it is not Servlet 6.1 compatible [#35354](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35354)
- Expose retry attempts in RetryException [#35351](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35351)
- RetryException#getCause should not be nullable [#35332](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35332)
- Refine CORS logging for non-processed requests due to no CORS configuration [#35314](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35314)
- Refine Jackson 3 constructors to accept only `JsonMapper` instances for JSON [#35282](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35282)
- Revise `StartupStep` to implement `AutoCloseable` [#35277](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35277)
- Add compression support in JdkClientHttpRequestFactory [#35225](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/35225)
- Add support for Micrometer context propagation in Kotlin coroutines [#35185](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35185)
- Add support for Forwarded By HTTP header [#34683](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/34683)
- Update HttpStatus to align with RFC9110 where relevant [#32870](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32870)
- `ContextCache` should close evicted context before loading new context [#21007](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21007)

- Refine `Nullness` for Kotlin functions returning `Unit` [#35420](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35420)

- RestTestClient returns null response body [#35385](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35385)
- Interface client methods that return InputStreams do not throw exceptions on bad HTTP status codes [#35375](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35375)

- Wrong PathPattern parsing for segments ending in '\*\*' [#35339](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35339)
- `RetryTemplate` should officially expose `RetryException` to `RetryListener.onRetryPolicyExhaustion()` [#35334](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35334)

:star: New Features

- Only add `httpServiceProxyRegistry` bean when necessary [#35307](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/35307)
- Introduce `@Proxyable` annotation for bean-specific proxy type [#35296](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35296)
- Introduce bean definition attribute for enforcing an interface-based proxy [#35293](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35293)
- Let Spring Boot consistently switch to CGLIB proxies for any proxy processor (including `@Retryable`, `@Async` etc.) [#35286](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35286)
- HTTP method support in MappedInterceptor [#35273](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/35273)
- Post process outgoing messages in JmsClient [#35271](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35271)
- Introduce `ConfigurableApplicationContext.pause()` and `SmartLifecycle.isPauseable()` [#35269](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35269)
- Provide support to configure request interceptors in RestTestClient [#35268](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35268)
- Provide more control over validation in DefaultApiVersionStrategy [#35267](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35267)
- PathApiVersionResolver should not be nullable [#35265](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35265)
- Replace `useRequestParam` with `useQueryParam` in `ApiVersionConfigurer` to align with client [#35263](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35263)
- Add support for MediaType in ApiVersionInserter [#35259](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35259)
- ApiVersionConfigurer misconfiguration is hard to detect when no version resolvers are added [#35256](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35256)
- Support HttpServiceClient annotation [#35244](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35244)
- Prefer mapping without version for requests without a version [#35237](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35237)
- Provide `@WebSocketScope` annotation and public `SCOPE_WEBSOCKET` constant (for consistency with `@RequestScope` and co) [#35235](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35235)
- Allow getting receipt from StompSession.Subscription.unsubscribe() [#35224](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/35224)
- Support wildcard path elements at the start of path patterns [#35213](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35213)
- Improve handling of request parameter without values in MockMvc [#35210](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35210)
- Display original request URI in NoResourceFoundException message [#34553](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34553)
- Add RestTestClient [#34428](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/34428)
- Support Hibernate StatelessSession [SPR-2495] [#7184](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/7184)

ll/v7.0.0-M7","zipball_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/spring-projects/spring-framework/zipball/v7.0.0-M7","body":"## :star: New Features

- LocalDataSourceJobStore should re-initialize statically registered Quartz ConnectionProvider on context restart [#35208](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35208)
- Make rootObject parameter consistently nullable [#35206](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35206)
- Refine multipart converter registration in HttpMessageConverters [#35203](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35203)
- Introduce `getSource()` in `ApplicationContextEvent` with covariant return type [#35197](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35197)
- Introduce `ContextRestartedEvent` as a subtype of `ContextStartedEvent` [#35194](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35194)
- Align HttpMessageConverters builder with WebFlux codecs variants [#35187](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35187)
- Transaction-scoped resource binding in `TransactionSynchronizationManager` [#35182](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35182)
- Use flexible generics nullness in `RestClient.RequestHeadersSpec.ExchangeFunction` [#35180](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35180)
- Introduce `ConfigurableApplicationContext.restart()` method [#35171](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35171)
- Pause unused application contexts in the TestContext framework [#35168](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35168)
- Skip initialization of a `NullBean` [#35165](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35165)
- Short-circuit matching algorithm in `InstanceFilter` [#35161](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35161)
- Support direct matching against exceptions in `ExceptionTypeFilter` [#35160](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35160)
- `InstanceFilter` and `ExceptionTypeFilter` should set `matchIfEmpty` to `true` by default [#35158](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35158)
- Require explicit constraints in `@Contract` [#35157](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35157)
- Specify fetchSize/maxRows/queryTimeout per statement in JdbcClient [#35155](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35155)
- Include MethodParameter[] parameters in HttpRequestValues.Processor [#35148](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35148)
- Deprecate `DaoSupport` classes [#35145](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35145)
- Remove `maxDuration`/`maxElapsedTime` support from `RetryPolicy` [#35144](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35144)
- Introduce `@ConcurrencyLimit` annotation based on `ConcurrencyThrottleInterceptor` [#35133](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35133)
- Consistently implement `toString()` in `BackOff` strategies [#35120](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35120)
- Support API versioning for functional endpoints [#35113](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35113)
- Migrate `orm.hibernate5` to `orm.jpa.hibernate` package for Hibernate ORM 7.0 [#35111](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35111)
- Redesign `RetryPolicy` to directly incorporate `BackOff` [#35110](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35110)
- Ability to limit list of supported API versions to explicitly configured ones for Spring MVC [#35105](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35105)
- Refine nullability of `PropertyResolver.getProperty(key: String)` extension [#35104](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35104)
- Support for exposing additional object types in `SmartFactoryBean` [#35101](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35101)
- Add missing `@Nullable` to `MethodInvoker::setArguments` parameter [#35089](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/35089)
- Support `@RequestBody` in interface method when computing "consumes" condition [#35086](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/35086)
- Consistent validation of supported API versions [#35082](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35082)
- Resolve optional HandlerMethod parameter of `@ExceptionHandler` method to null [#35067](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35067)
- Add ability to decorate HttpExchangeAdapter through HttpServiceProxyFactory [#35059](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35059)
- Introduce `Builder` API and factory methods for `RetryPolicy` [#35058](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35058)
- Revise `RetryTemplate` for alignment with Reactor (in preparation for `@Retryable`) [#35057](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35057)
- Add ApiVersionResolver based on parameter in media type [#35050](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35050)
- Support deprecation information in API versioning [#35049](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35049)
- Add support for configuring `SslInfo` in `WebTestClient` [#35042](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35042)
- Make built-in `RetryPolicy` implementations `final` [#35040](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35040)
- Specify flexible generics nullness in spring-jdbc [#34911](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34911)
- Allow usage of `@CheckReturnValue` on types and constructors [#34910](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34910)
- Support repeatable writes in FormHttpMessageConverter#writeMultipart [#34859](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34859)
- Convert applicable methods in `Scope` to `default` methods [#34757](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/34757)
- Add public method to get bean order [#34712](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34712)
- Discard further rows once maxRows has been reached [#34709](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/34709)
- Support `DefaultWebFilterChain` allowing the current filter to provide its name explicitly [#34702](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34702)
- API Versioning Support [#34565](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34565)
- Introduce `@Retryable` AOP support (based on `core.retry` and Reactor retry functionality) [#34529](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34529)
- Revisit converters and codecs default setup in HTTP stacks  [#33894](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33894)
- `ConfigurationBeanNameGenerator` for `@Bean`-annotated methods [#33448](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33448)
- Qualified `EntityManager`/`EntityManagerFactory` injection (aligned with Jakarta Persistence 3.2) [#33414](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33414)
- Introduce JmsClient with customizable send/receive operations [#32501](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32501)
- Allow conditional handling of 404 with HTTP Interface clients [#32105](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32105)
- Allow to set TTL (and other QoS-related settings) on a per-message (and/or per-send) basis [#26840](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26840)

## :lady_beetle: Bug Fixes

- Allow ordering of `HttpMessageConverters`s through `WebMvcConfigurer.configureMessageConverters(HttpMessageConverters.Builder)` [#35177](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35177)
- Content-Disposition response header duplicated for failed StreamingResponseBody [#35116](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35116)
- CachingMetadataReaderFactory does not cache all metadatareader calls [#35112](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35112)
- `sslInfo()` should return the builder for `MockServerHttpRequest` [#35075](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35075)
- HttpService group adapters could not be instantiated in a native image [#35038](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/35038)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Improve URLs in Validation chapter of the reference manual [#35181](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35181)
- Update Spring MVC message converters documentation [#35166](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35166)
- Add a note about Field/Method vs. TYPE\_USE annotations in reference docs [#35098](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35098)
- Document intention of `toString()` in `HandlerMethod` [#35055](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/35055)
- Add section in docs on byte-range requests in Spring MVC and WebFlux [#35052](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35052)

- Update HttpServiceGroupConfigurer API [#34926](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34926)
- Make `ProblemDetailJacksonXmlMixin` compatible with Jackson 3 [#34925](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/34925)
- Introduce hints in `RestClient` API [#34924](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34924)
- Add Kotlin body advices [#34923](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34923)
- Add support for callable references to `BeanRegistrarDsl` [#34922](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34922)
- Additional updates for API versioning in test and client support [#34919](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34919)
- Define nullability `@Contract` for `quote` and `getFilename` in `StringUtils` [#34896](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/34896)
- Support `@Import` on interfaces [#34820](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/34820)
- Use HexFormat in CharacterEditor [#34798](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/34798)
- Use HexFormat in ContentDisposition [#34797](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/34797)
- Introduce minimal retry functionality as a core framework feature [#34716](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/34716)
- Add support for "application/\*+x-protobuf" media type [#34645](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/34645)
- Support OutputStream and InputStream in HTTP Interface clients [#32358](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32358)

- Beans created by FactoryBean are not considered as autowiring candidates if another thread holds a singletonLock [#34902](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34902)

- Accidental ClassLoader defineClass enforcement after #34677 [#34824](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34824)
- HttpEntity.EMPTY headers should not be possible to mutate via HttpHeaders constructor [#34812](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/34812)

- Correctly expand query param with same name from URI variables array  [#34783](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/34783)
- R2DBC `NamedParameterUtils` only expands reused collection parameter once [#34768](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34768)

:star: New Features

- Make BeanDefinitionPropertyValueCodeGeneratorDelegates public [#34761](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34761)
- Add AOT support for Registry of HTTP Interface Proxies [#34750](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34750)
- Make HttpServiceGroupConfigurer extend Ordered. [#34739](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/34739)
- Introduce `queryParamCount()` in `MockRestRequestMatchers` [#34703](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34703)
- Add method level callback for HttpRequestValues initialization [#34699](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34699)
- Refine `UriUtils#decode` and `StringUtils#uriDecode` implementation and documentation [#34673](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/34673)
- Add visibility and return type to SimpleMethodMetadata toString [#34649](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34649)
- Revise `RepeatableContainers` API to better guide developers [#34637](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34637)
- Extract `AnnotatedElementAdapter` to public type [#34628](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34628)
- Add support for `ImportAware` in `BeanRegistrar` [#34627](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34627)
- Introduce Stream variant methods for SqlQuery [#34623](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/34623)
- Generate compiled SpEL expressions using Java 17 byte code level [#34602](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34602)
- Allow adding bean name aliases in the programmatic bean registration DSL [#34599](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34599)
- Support API Versioning in Tests [#34568](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34568)
- Support API Versioning on the Client Side [#34567](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34567)
- Propagate `CoroutineContext` to the `CoExchangeFilterFunction` [#34555](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/34555)
- Introduce `OptionalToObjectConverter` [#34544](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34544)
- Create Registry for HTTP Interface Proxies with Extensible Registration DSL [#33992](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33992)
- Reconsider log level for `final` methods on CGLIB proxy classes [#33939](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33939)
- Enforce Servlet 6.1 and WebSocket 2.2 baselines [#33918](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33918)
- Consider ClassFile API for reading class metadata from bytecode [#33616](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33616)
- Give `JdbcClient` access to `ConversionService` for converting custom database object types [#33467](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33467)
- Consider not rejecting preflight requests when no CORS configuration is provided [#31839](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31839)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Turn "CDS" documentation into a "JVM AOT cache" one [#34700](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34700)
- Document that `attribute` is optional in `@⁠AliasFor` for overrides with the same name [#34641](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34641)
- Reinstate links to JUnit 5 Javadoc APIs [#27497](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27497)

- Upgrade to Kotlin 2.1.20 [#34632](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34632)
- Upgrade to Micrometer 1.15.0-RC1 [#34771](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34771)

:star: New Features

- An option for SimpleAsyncTaskExecutor to throw an exception when limit is reached [#34727](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34727)
- Provide first-class support for Bean Overrides with `@ContextHierarchy` [#34723](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/34723)
- Micro performance optimizations [#34717](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/34717)
- Suppress "Unable to rollback against JDBC Connection" in case of timeout (connection closed) [#34714](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34714)
- Avoid early FactoryBean instantiation for type-based retrieval with includeNonSingletons=false and allowEagerInit=true [#34710](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34710)
- ReactiveCachingHandler still not using error handler on sync cache. [#34708](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34708)
- Add an `exchangeForRequiredValue` variant to `RestClient` [#34692](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34692)
- Recursively boxing Kotlin nested value classes in `CoroutinesUtils` [#34682](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/34682)
- ServletServerHttpRequest does not use charset parameter of application/x-www-form-urlencoded [#34675](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34675)
- LifecycleGroup concurrent start and start timeout [#34634](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34634)
- HibernateJpaDialect exception translation misses concrete exceptions wrapped in Hibernate's ExecutionException [#34633](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34633)

## :lady_beetle: Bug Fixes

- Inconsistency in `SseEmitter.onCompletion()` behavior between Spring 6.2.3 and 6.2.5 [#34762](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34762)
- Deadlock while creating Spring beans with parallel bootstrap threads on IBM Liberty [#34729](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34729)
- `PropertyBatchUpdateException`: causes of nested `PropertyAccessException`s not shown in output [#34691](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34691)
- IllegalAccessError for package-private member of AzureStorageConfiguration on WebSphere [#34684](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34684)
- Change in Jar usecache behavior with Spring 6.1.x causing java.lang.IllegalStateException: zip file closed [#34678](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34678)
- Startup performance regression due to CGLIB class load attempts in Spring 6.1.x [#34677](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34677)
- An infinite wait on a parallel context.getBean() [#34672](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34672)
- InvalidObservationException: Invalid start: Observation 'http.client.requests' has already been started [#34671](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34671)
- `@Configuration` classes can no longer be `abstract` without `@Bean` methods [#34663](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34663)
- Generated-code for LinkedHashMap is missing static keyword [#34659](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34659)
- Detect late-set primary markers for autowiring shortcut algorithm [#34658](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34658)
- `@MockitoBean` with custom `@Qualifier` is not injected into `@Configuration` class [#34646](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34646)
- Qualifier Resolution Issue in Parent-Child Context Hierarchies [#34644](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34644)
- Enforced container-level acknowledge call for custom acknowledgement mode [#34635](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34635)
- UriComponentsBuilder does not treat a URN as opaque if it contains a slash [#34588](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34588)
- Migrating from Spring 6.1.x to 6.2.x leads to exceptions in a Pekko setup [#34303](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34303)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Update Javadoc for `ignoreDependencyInterface()` in `AbstractAutowireCapableBeanFactory` [#34747](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/34747)
- Update Javadoc to stop mentioning 5.3.x as the status quo [#34740](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34740)
- Fix broken link for Server-Sent Events [#34705](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/34705)
- Fix typo in Bean Validation section of reference manual [#34686](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/34686)
- Remove unnecessary closing curly brackets in Javadoc [#34679](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/34679)
- Add javadoc notes on potential exception suppression in `ListableBeanFactory#getBeansOfType` [#34629](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34629)
- Remove remaining references to Forwarded headers in MvcUriComponentsBuilder [#34625](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34625)

.0.0-M3","zipball_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/spring-projects/spring-framework/zipball/v7.0.0-M3","body":"## :star: New Features

- First-class support for `BeanRegistrar` registration on `GenericApplicationContext` [#34574](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34574)
- Support API Versioning in Request Mappings [#34566](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34566)
- Remove support for `Aware` interfaces in `BeanRegistrar` [#34562](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34562)
- Add support for target type to `BeanRegistry` [#34560](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34560)
- Allow chained BeanRegistry registration [#34557](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/34557)
- Remove deprecated `rowsExpected` property of `SqlQuery` [#34530](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34530)
- Upgrade NullAway to 0.12.4 [#34525](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34525)
- Improve SimpleKey hashing function [#34483](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34483)
- Revisit MockHttpServletResponse after Servlet API clarifications [#34467](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34467)
- Refine Kotlin serialization converters/codecs conditions [#34438](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34438)
- Support open polymorphism with Kotlin Serialization [#34433](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34433)
- SseEmitter IOException on HTTP Connection Close [#33832](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33832)
- Remove convention-based annotation attribute override support [#28761](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28761)
- Support `Optional` with null-safe and Elvis operators in SpEL expressions [#20433](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/20433)
- Programmatic bean registration with configuration classes [#18353](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/18353)

## :lady_beetle: Bug Fixes

- Upgrade match check in WebSocketHandlerMapping does not work if handler mapped to `"/*"` [#34503](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34503)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Refine Kotlin serialization reference documentation [#34437](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34437)

## :hammer: Dependency Upgrades

- Upgrade to Reactor 2025.0.0-M1 [#34577](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34577)

.2.4","zipball_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/spring-projects/spring-framework/zipball/v6.2.4","body":"## :star: New Features

- JettyCoreHttpHandlerAdapter compatibility with Jetty 12.0.17 [#34561](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34561)
- HandlerMethodValidationException.Visitor should support RequestBody with method parameter constraints [#34549](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34549)
- Allow `ContentResultMatchersDsl` matchers for supertypes of the checked type [#34542](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/34542)
- Avoid `JarURLConnection` resource leak in `AbstractFileResolvingResource.exists()` [#34528](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34528)
- Deprecate `rowsExpected` property of `SqlQuery` for removal [#34526](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/34526)
- Supply `RuntimeHints` to an `AotContextLoader` [#34513](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34513)
- Deprecate and remove use of UrlPathHelper in ServletWebSocketHandlerRegistry [#34508](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34508)
- Avoid unnecessary CGLIB processing on configuration classes [#34486](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34486)
- Inconsistent default class loaders in hint classes [#34470](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34470)
- Add missing converters to `DefaultRestClientBuilder` [#34439](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34439)
- Improve `BeanFactory`/`ObjectProvider` to select the only one default candidate among non-default candidates [#34432](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34432)

## :lady_beetle: Bug Fixes

- `MockCookie.parse()` fails to parse custom attribute with a value [#34575](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34575)
- `BeanNotOfRequiredTypeException` if `@Bean` factory method returns `null` [#34543](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34543)
- Regression in 6.2.3: No unique bean available for injection point with unresolvable generics [#34541](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34541)
- GenericConversionService cannot find a converter when converting to a Kotlin list of maps [#34535](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34535)
- isClientDisconnectedException needs to protect against null input [#34533](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34533)
- spring boot 3.4.3 + TimedAspect causes thread to hang [#34522](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34522)
- Missing Partitioned cookie support in reactive HTTP clients [#34521](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/34521)
- DefaultManagedTaskExecutor throws java.lang.UnsupportedOperationException: isShutdown when rejecting tasks [#34514](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34514)
- FileSystemResource location does not end with slash for RouterFunction check [#34509](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34509)
- AbstractJackson2HttpMessageConverter not resolving generic type for request body since 6.2.3 [#34504](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34504)
- Request param handling in HttpRequestValues overrides existing URI variables with same name [#34499](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34499)
- MockHttpServletResponse - handle multiple values for Content-Language header [#34488](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34488)
- Endless loop with DataSourceUtils in spring-jdbc [#34484](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34484)
- MockHttpServletResponse#setHeader does not remove header for null values [#34464](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34464)
- ContentCachingResponseWrapper.setHeader does not handle null value properly. [#34460](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34460)
- Component scan fails to find bean candidates in the embedded jar file in META-INF/context.xml for embedded Tomcat application [#34446](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34446)
- 6.2.0 broke with "Could not register object [`@someHash`] under bean name 'blabla': there is already object [`@sameHash`] bound" [#34427](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34427)
- 503 status code after completing SseEmitter in onTimeout [#34426](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34426)
- `NullPointerException` thrown when `ConfigurationClassEnhancer` creates CGLIB proxy [#34423](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34423)
- Add onRequest() hook for propagating request from downstream [#34388](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/34388)
- Content-Type response header duplicated for failed StreamingResponseBody return value [#34366](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34366)
- Task scheduler configured by XML is not eligible for getting processed by all BeanPostProcessors [#34015](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34015)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Fix typo in Spring MVC error responses documentation [#34552](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/34552)
- Document that Spring Framework 6.x does not yet support JSpecify annotations [#34551](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34551)
- Fix web and webflux reference links [#34517](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/34517)
- Document default KeyGenerator in spring-cache XSD [#34468](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/34468)
- Fix broken antora task [#34454](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34454)
- Add `@since` tag for formField() and formFields in MockHttpServletRequestDsl [#34448](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/34448)
- Improve Javadoc of ObjectProvider to clarify what is unique [#34447](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/34447)
- rest-http-interface example code can't run [#34443](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34443)
- Add Javadoc since for HandlerMethod(HandlerMethod, Object, boolean) [#34431](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/34431)
- Document wrapping behavior of `TestExecutionListener` callbacks [#34422](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34422)
- Cross reference annotation search APIs in Javadoc [#34421](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34421)

:star: New Features

- Add form fields to MockMvc Kotlin DSL [#34412](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/34412)
- Make ProblemDetail implement Serializable [#34409](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34409)
- Support `@MockitoSpyBean` at the type level on test classes [#34408](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34408)
- Expose order values of `TestExecutionListener` implementations as constants [#34404](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34404)
- ContentDisposition should match attributes in a case-insensitive fashion [#34383](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/34383)
- Provide access to servletPath in ServletRequestPathUtils [#34379](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34379)
- Use `ConversionService` to convert POJO to array for SpEL varargs invocations [#34371](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34371)
- Provide a more actionable CGLIB error message with native [#34370](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34370)
- Wrap disconnected client exceptions as AsyncRequestNotUsableException in Servlet container onError callback [#34363](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34363)
- Support RFC 8441 WebSocket upgrade with HTTP/2 CONNECT [#34362](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/34362)
- Optimize default property editor allocations for bean instance creation [#34361](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34361)

- Change in BeanFactoryUtils.beanNamesForTypeIncludingAncestors() Behavior in Spring Framework 6.2.x causing ClassCastExceptions [#34300](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34300)
- Data binding does not filter HTTP headers for constructor binding [#34292](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34292)
- Escaped character in nested placeholder not detected properly and leads to invalid parts [#34289](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34289)
- ReflectJvmMapping.getKotlinFunction returns null for Kotlin properties [#34284](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34284)

- Revise cookies support with Apache HTTP Components in WebClient and WebTestClient [#33822](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33822)
- Remove the `pure` attribute from `@Contract` [#33820](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33820)
- Introduce `@CheckReturnValue` annotation [#33818](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33818)
- ResourceHttpRequestHandler throwing IllegalArgumentException if resource doesn't end with slash breaks some third-party libraris [#33815](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33815)
- Provide first-class virtual thread option on `ThreadPoolTaskExecutor`/`ThreadPoolTaskScheduler` [#33807](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33807)
- `HttpServiceProxyFactory` should omit optional `@RequestParam` if converted from `null` to empty string [#33794](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33794)
- Reactor Netty response should not buffer the full response [#33781](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33781)
- Relax the visibility of MockMVC DSL constructors [#33778](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/33778)
- Support Publisher to InputStream conversion [#31677](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/31677)

- Deprecate exchangeTimeout and refactor readTimeout in ReactorClientHttpRequestFactory [#33782](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33782)

- Add URL Parser for RFC 3986 [#33639](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33639)
- Handle X-Forwarded-Prefix parsed by Reactor-Netty in ReactorServerHttpRequest [#33638](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/33638)
- RestClient should auto-detect ReactorClientHttpRequestFactory [#33635](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33635)

- Stop replacing existing Bean Override definitions with pseudo-definitions [#33627](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33627)

- Add utility methods for resource handler checks [#33574](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33574)
- UrlHandlerFilter should not strip the trailing slash from the contextPath URL [#33565](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33565)
- AbstractGenericHttpMessageConverter has no constructor taking a Charset [#33563](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33563)
- JdbcClient ResultQuerySpec - Provide a optionalValue() method [#33560](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33560)

- Add `RestClient.Builder#messageConverters(List)` [#33536](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33536)
