- With virtual threads enabled, long-running `fixedDelay` tasks block `fixedRate` tasks [#33408](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33408)
- Provide a public mechanism for detecting if AOT processing is in progress [#33388](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33388)
- Use only one request timeout mechanism in JdkClientHttpRequest [#33090](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/33090)
- Support bean override features with AOT and native image [#32933](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32933)
- Limit reflective operations in `BeanInstanceSupplier` with Spring AOT [#32834](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32834)

ork/tarball/v6.2.0-RC1","zipball_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/spring-projects/spring-framework/zipball/v6.2.0-RC1","body":"## :star: New Features

- Update `mime.types` and remove commented entries [#33512](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33512)
- Provide access to the unexpanded URI template when using MockMvc [#33509](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33509)
- Avoid empty array allocations in AnnotationTypeMapping [#33507](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/33507)
- Introduce `DynamicPropertyRegistrar` as a replacement for `DynamicPropertyRegistry` bean support [#33501](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33501)
- Avoid storing duplicate empty array in MethodParameter field [#33496](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/33496)
- Avoid empty array allocations in ResolvableType [#33473](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/33473)
- Update Content-Length when body changed by Interceptor [#33459](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/33459)
- UrlHandlerFilter should not strip the trailing slash from root URLs [#33444](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33444)
- Unwrap CGLIB proxy when invoking non-proxied methods in `ReflectionTestUtils` [#33429](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33429)
- Refactor eTag formatting logic into a static utility method [#33412](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/33412)
- Encapsulate ETag comparison logic [#33385](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33385)
- Harmonize Reactor client class names within the `http.client` package [#33382](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33382)
- Allow multiple listeners on ResponseBodyEmitter [#33356](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33356)
- Invoke init/destroy/SpEL methods via public declaring type whenever possible [#33216](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33216)
- Create WebFlux equivalent filter to handle URLs with trailing slashes  [#32830](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32830)
- Provide more ways to stream through ServerResponse for WebMvc functional endpoints [#32710](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32710)
- Avoid buffering all elements before sending JSON when using Flux/Flow + Kotlinx Serialization Encoder [#33428](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33428)

## :lady_beetle: Bug Fixes

- `BeanCurrentlyInCreationException` is thrown when multiple threads get a bean from `StaticApplicationContext`'s Bean Factory [#33463](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33463)

- Revise reference documentation for Spring JMX annotations [#33466](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33466)

- Consolidate self injection documentation in the reference manual [#33454](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33454)
- Expand acronyms `FQN` and `FQCN` [#33452](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/33452)
- Document that WebFlux does not support forward redirects [#33441](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33441)
- Document TaskDecorator usage with TaskExecutors [#33438](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33438)

:star: New Features

- Improve optional parameter checks for HTTP Interface argument [#33339](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/33339)
- Two `@Bean` methods with the same bean name should consistently throw an exception [#33330](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33330)
- Support static headers for http interface clients [#33309](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33309)
- Add DatabaseClient bind variant for list of positioned parameters [#33274](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33274)
- `HandlerMethodValidator` should support simple Cross-Parameter constraints [#33271](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33271)
- UserCredentialsConnectionFactoryAdapter should provide credentials to createContext [#33270](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33270)
- Support flexible multi-unit duration format in `@DurationFormat` [#33262](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33262)
- MockMvc should prepare a FilterRegistration when initializing filters [#33252](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33252)
- Add option to ignore bean registration with AOT [#33243](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33243)
- Support JAXBElement in Jaxb2RootElementHttpMessageConverter [#33233](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/33233)
- MimeMessageHelper does not set filename on inline MimeBodyPart [#33230](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33230)
- Add handling for AsyncRequestNotUsableException to ResponseEntityExceptionHandler [#33225](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33225)
- Allow formatting of Collection values for `@RequestParam` with HTTP interface client [#33220](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/33220)
- Support rendering stream of fragments [#33194](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33194)
- Allow resolving nested placeholders if value is not `String` but `CharSequence` [#32876](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/32876)
- Support multiple style of parsing/printing Durations [#30396](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/30396)
- Restore support for Freemarker request parameters and taglibs now that it supports Jakarta [#30186](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30186)
- AOT/native support when registering beans with the Kotlin DSL [#29555](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29555)
- Offer a way for MockitoTestExecutionListener to enable strict stubbing [#33318](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33318)
- Provide access to all counters in case of BatchUpdateException with multiple batches [#23867](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23867)
- Low level cache failure for sync/reactive/future Cacheable get is not handled by CacheErrorHandler [#21590](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21590)

- JdbcClient.MappedQuerySpec::single can return null  [#33300](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33300)
- Registration of `DynamicPropertyRegistry` in a test context has broken native testing [#33272](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33272)

- Document that SpEL expressions using bean references are not compilable [#33363](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33363)
- Remove duplicated "the" in Javadoc [#33308](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/33308)

:star: New Features

- Harmonize handling of current factory method in SimpleInstantiationStrategy [#33192](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33192)
- Unwrap `InvocationTargetException` in SpEL's `FunctionReference` [#33174](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33174)
- Support rendering multiple fragments  [#33162](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33162)
- Allow MessageHeaderAccessor to be created with existing headers [#33153](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33153)
- Generalize message conversion for HTTP message content in AssertJ support [#33148](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33148)
- Allow arbitrary packages to be scanned for Reflective usage [#33132](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33132)
- Support external methods referenced by fully-qualified name in `@TestBean` [#33125](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33125)
- Update `Content-Type` based on `encoding` in MVC `FreeMarkerView` [#33119](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33119)
- Introduce `SmartHttpMessageConverter` [#33118](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33118)
- Support property placeholders in `@Sql` script paths [#33114](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33114)
- Reject `ModelMap` argument types in WebFlux [#33109](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33109)
- Set `output_encoding` in `FreeMarkerView` implementations [#33106](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33106)
- Allow encoding to be set with a `Charset` in FreeMarker support [#33102](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33102)
- Let custom `ObjectProvider` implementations declare a single method only [#33070](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33070)
- Add support for running assertions on resolved exception in MockMvcTester [#33060](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33060)
- Add dedicated support for printing the MvcResult in MockMvcTester [#33059](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33059)
- Provide a way to determine if a context is in the process of being closed [#33058](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33058)
- MockHttpServletRequestBuilder should merge URI from the parent if necessary [#33057](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33057)
- Fail fast if a `@Bean` method declares `@Autowired` as well [#33051](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33051)
- Add dedicated async dispatch support for MockMvcTester [#33040](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33040)
- Add dedicated multipart support for MockMvcTester [#33027](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33027)
- spring-form JSP tags should escape HTML value based on response character encoding [#33023](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/33023)
- SimpleClientHttpResponse throws IOException when response body is empty and status code is >= 400 [#33020](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33020)
- `MockHttpServletResponse` defaults to ISO-8859-1 for JSON while the rest of the framework defaults to UTF-8 [#33019](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33019)
- Propagate context to message converters when streaming with Flux in Spring MVC [#32813](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32813)
- Resolve URI to baseUrl in RestClient [#32679](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32679)
- Constructor data binding support for List, Map and array arguments [#32426](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32426)
- Implement Eclipse Jetty core HTTP handler adapter [#32097](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/32097)
- Add better control over generated files registration [#31331](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31331)
- Provide more declarative control over reflection hint registration [#29194](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29194)
- Replace `@Nonnull(when = When.MAYBE) ` by `@CheckForNull` in `@Nullable` [#27183](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27183)
- Add JSON support to Protobuf codecs [#25457](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25457)

## :lady_beetle: Bug Fixes

- AntPathPatternMatcher hardcoded "/" separator in variables matching and comparator [#33085](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/33085)
- AOT generates a raw type for a generic type with nested unresolved generics [#33069](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33069)
- Unwrap Kotlin inline value classes return values [#33026](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33026)
- Kotlin Serialization support does not take null-safety into account [#33016](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33016)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Move Testing below other framework concerns in the reference documentation TOC [#33083](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33083)
- Move Servlet HTTP Message Conversion to its own section [#33063](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33063)
- Document AssertJ support for MockMvc [#32454](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32454)

- Ensure varargs component type for `MethodHandle` is not `null` in SpEL's `ReflectionHelper` [#33193](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33193)
- Confusing WebClient exception message in case of Reactor-Netty `PrematureCloseException` during response [#33127](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33127)
- Include the bean name in the exception when an invalid factoryBeanObjectType attribute is found [#33117](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33117)
- Use error handler for reactive cache aspect [#33073](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/33073)
- `getTypeForFactoryMethod` should catch `NoClassDefFoundError` [#33075](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33075)

## :lady_beetle: Bug Fixes

- SpEL cannot invoke varargs `MethodHandle` function with an array [#33191](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33191)
- SpEL cannot invoke varargs `MethodHandle` function with zero variable arguments [#33190](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33190)
- Nested bean instance supplier invocation does not retain previous factory method [#33180](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33180)
- DefaultErrorResponseBuilder does not implement headers(Consumer) [#33156](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/33156)
- Fix adaptation of violations on Set method parameter [#33150](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/33150)
- Web controller call with invalid body resulting in 500 instead of 400 when using kotlinx-serialization [#33138](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33138)
- "file:." cannot be resolved to `java.nio.file.Path` (and plain "." value resolves to classpath root) [#33124](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33124)
- Mockito mock falsely initialized as CGLIB proxy with AspectJ aspect [#33113](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33113)
- Fix ClassCastException from return value validation with proxy when adaptConstraintViolations=true [#33105](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/33105)
- Spring coroutines AOP is not compatible with `@Transactional` [#33095](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33095)
- ReactorClientHttpConnector creates new HttpClient for every request [#33093](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33093)
- Trace and Span IDs are no longer propagated RequestBodyAdvice beans [#33091](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33091)
- Early `LocalContainerEntityManagerFactoryBean` initialization fails in case of null bean definition [#33082](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33082)
- `ReactorNettyClientRequest.convertException` should include original exception if cause is `null` [#33080](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33080)
- SpEL incorrectly splits string arguments by comma for `Object...` varargs method [#33013](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33013)
- ProtobufMessageConverter fails to parse JSON payload if byte array is used [#27408](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27408)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Harmonize phrasing in URI Encoding section [#33166](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/33166)
- Document that `ModelMap` is not a supported argument type in WebFlux [#33107](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33107)
- Example in Method Injection section of Spring Framework documentation refers to wrong bean names [#33096](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33096)
- Resource writer doesn't consider subclasses of `InputStreamResource` for content length bypass [#33089](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33089)
- Improve documentation regarding encoding in FreeMarker support [#33071](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33071)
- Exception for validation failure in WebFlux does not match the documentation [#33061](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33061)

## :hammer: Dependency Upgrades

- Upgrade to Kotlin 1.9.24 [#33177](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33177)
- Upgrade to Kotlin Serialization 1.6.3 [#33175](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33175)
- Upgrade to Micrometer 1.12.8 [#33168](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33168)
- Upgrade to Reactor 2023.0.8 [#33169](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33169)

rk/tarball/v6.2.0-M4","zipball_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/spring-projects/spring-framework/zipball/v6.2.0-M4","body":"## :star: New Features

- Add support for converting the whole JSON document without using JSONPath [#33018](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33018)
- Support Protobuf 4.x [#33011](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33011)
- Do not swallow exceptions on failing to release a savepoint [#32992](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/32992)
- Being able to provide extended timeouts for specific phases in the DefaultLifecycleProcessor [#32985](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32985)
- Allow json content to be converted using AssertJ's AssertFactory [#32953](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32953)
- Add support for `BeanPostProcessor` defined in Kotlin `companion object` [#32946](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32946)
- Support `@TestBean` factory methods defined in interfaces [#32943](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32943)
- Add a way to set the timeout to reactive jdk client [#32941](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/32941)
- Revise convention-based semantics for `@TestBean` factory methods [#32940](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32940)
- Support field name as fallback qualifier for `@TestBean`, `MockitoBean`, and `MockitoSpyBean` [#32939](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32939)
- Use getMessageSource internally in RequestContext [#32926](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/32926)
- MockMvc no longer needs methods that take a String httpMethod for custom methods [#32914](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32914)
- Allow MockMvcTester to prepare the query without the need of static imports [#32913](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32913)
- Rework Bean Overriding feature to better behave with TCF Context Caching [#32884](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32884)
- Introduce API to initialize `BeanFactory` before singleton instantiation [#32836](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32836)
- Introduce static `MultiValueMap` factory methods [#32832](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32832)
- Make use of JSONAssert in public API optional [#32791](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32791)
- Refine exception handling in AOT process to provide additional context [#32777](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32777)
- Handle ResponseStatusException thrown by MVC functional endpoints [#32689](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32689)
- Support data binding from request headers [#32676](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32676)
- Ignore trailing semicolons when parsing Accept-Language header [#32259](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/32259)
- Introduce request attributes in RestClient [#32027](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32027)
- Make WebSocketMessageBrokerStats optionally export stats to micrometer [#31604](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31604)
- Add Partitioned cookie attribute support for reactive servers [#31454](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31454)
- Add execution metadata to scheduled tasks [#24560](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24560)

## :lady_beetle: Bug Fixes

- Exception that prevents component scan with REGISTER\_BEAN conditions should provide the affected configuration class [#32998](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32998)
- Bean override with REPLACE\_OR\_CREATE\_DEFINITION and byType lookup fails if no match is found [#32990](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32990)
- Bean override factory post processing doesn't work with `FactoryBean` [#32971](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32971)
- `@TestBean` factory method not found in multi-level `@Nested` hierarchy [#32951](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32951)
- Support queries in opaque URLs [#32920](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32920)
- AbstractJsonContentAssert should allow satistfies to run on the json content, not the raw string [#32894](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32894)
- Content negotiation for exception handling fails with WebFlux [#32878](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32878)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Fix typo in WebTestClient expectedXml [#32969](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/32969)

## :hammer: Dependency Upgrades

- Upgrade to Micrometer 1.13.1 [#33000](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33000)
- Upgrade to Reactor 2024.0.0-M3 [#33006](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33006)

- Behaviour change in ScheduledAnnotationBeanPostProcessor: canceling scheduled tasks on ContextClosedEvent v6.0 -> v6.1 [#33009](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33009)
- ContentCachingRequestWrapper  may allocate too much memory [#32987](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32987)
- Support `canEncode()` for `JAXBElement` in `Jaxb2XmlEncoder` [#32977](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/32977)
- AspectJ CTW aspects executed twice [#32970](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32970)
- `@Valid` annotations on container elements for handler argument validation not supported [#32964](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32964)

- ConcurrentHashMap.computeIfAbsent used in AdvisedSupport can cause virtual thread pinning [#32958](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32958)
- Exception mapping does not work as expected when plugging in ReactorNettyClientRequestFactory into RestTemplate and RestClient [#32952](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32952)

- SpEL compilation fails when indexing into a `Map` with a primitive [#32903](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32903)

- Application not starting with `@EnableTransactionManagement`(mode = AdviceMode.ASPECTJ)  [#32882](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32882)
- ReactorNettyClientResponse should not throw exception if no body is available [#32805](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32805)

:star: New Features

- Make it easier to register reflection hints on interface hierarchies [#32824](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32824)
- Support varargs invocations in SpEL for varargs array subtype in compiled expressions [#32804](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/32804)
- Align StandaloneMockMvcBuilder with trailing slash defaults [#32796](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/32796)
- Use lambda expressions consistently [#32765](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/32765)
- Bean overriding in tests should use by-type semantic if no name is specified [#32761](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32761)
- Add `ServerRequest.pathVariableOrNull` Kotlin extension [#32738](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/32738)
- Throw an exception for suspending factory methods [#32719](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32719)
- Introduce `ReflectiveIndexAccessor` convenience class in SpEL [#32714](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32714)
- Add `BodyInserters.fromValue(T, ParameterizedTypeReference<T>)` and related APIs [#32713](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32713)
- Rename AssertableMockMvc to MvcTester and review assertions structure [#32712](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32712)
- Introduce `generateCodeForArgument()` in `CodeFlow` [#32708](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32708)
- Make `SpelNode` compilation aware [#32707](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32707)
- Add a `requiredBody()` extension to `RestClient.ResponseSpec` [#32703](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/32703)
- Add `IndexAccessor` support to SpEL's `SimpleEvaluationContext` [#32702](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32702)
- Support compilation of array and list indexing with `Integer` in SpEL [#32694](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32694)
- Avoid unnecessary compilation attempts in SpEL's `Indexer` [#32677](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32677)
- Adds support for qualifying columns with table. [#32653](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/32653)
- Omit empty resource description in `DeprecatedBeanWarner`'s log message [#32647](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/32647)
- Introduce `getName()` in SpEL's `BeanReference` [#32640](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32640)
-  Validate that `private` JUnit Jupiter lifecycle methods are not annotated with `@Autowired`  [#32627](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32627)
- Ensure removal of `Content-Type` header if body `Publisher` is empty [#32622](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/32622)
- Introduce `CompilableIndexAccessor` SPI in SpEL [#32613](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32613)
- AbstractJackson2Decoder doesn't support decoding NDJSON arrays into Flux<List> [#32579](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32579)
- Handle DataBufferLimitException as HTTP 413 responses [#32558](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/32558)
- Introduce URL parser based on algorithm provided in Living URL standard [#32513](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32513)
- JettyClientHttpRequestFactory should set request/response timeout [#32330](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32330)
- Remove Hibernate substitutions and deprecated properties usage [#32314](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32314)
- Register `DynamicPropertyRegistry` as a singleton bean in a test's `ApplicationContext` [#32271](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32271)
- Allow for AbstractUrlHandlerMapping to add/remove handlers at runtime [#32064](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/32064)
- Make it possible for Spring Security to align with Spring MVC without HandlerMappingIntrospector  [#31823](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31823)
- Create Filter to handle URLs with trailing slashes [#31366](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31366)
- Add testing support for WebMvc.fn [#30477](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30477)
- Use URL and HTTP method in DefaultResponseErrorHandler [#28958](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/28958)
- CacheAspectSupport initialization failure should throw dedicated exceptions, rather than IllegalStateException [#22442](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22442)
- Clear AspectJExpressionPointcut cache when it is no longer used [#12334](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/12334)

## :lady_beetle: Bug Fixes

- `MediaTypeAssert` risk false negative with `isNotEqual` assertion [#32756](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32756)
- `IndexAccessor` cannot support custom `Collection` target type [#32736](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32736)
- Custom `IndexAccessor` cannot support `String` index type [#32706](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32706)
- HttpHeaders should reject negative ContentLength values [#32660](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/32660)

- Document SpEL `IndexAccessor` support in the reference manual [#32735](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32735)
- Use lowercase package name in code snippets [#32734](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32734)

l/v6.1.7","zipball_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/spring-projects/spring-framework/zipball/v6.1.7","body":"## :star: New Features

- ResponseEntity<Resource> is not reliably closed with InputStreamResource [#32802](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32802)
- Accept ajc-compiled `@Aspect` classes for Spring AOP proxy usage [#32793](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32793)
- Failure to process a bean definition ahead-of-time with an instance supplier should provide more contextual information [#32775](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32775)
- Provide methods to unambiguously send form data with MockMvc [#32757](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32757)
- Introduce NoOp implementation for ResponseErrorHandler [#32750](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32750)
- Support varargs invocations in SpEL for varargs array subtype [#32704](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/32704)
- StreamUtils.copyRange overreads source stream in some cases [#32695](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32695)
- Modify error message when timeout is less than TIMEOUT\_DEFAULT [#32635](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/32635)
- Jetty HttpConnections not closed with SSE on Jetty 12.0.7+ when clients close the connection [#32629](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32629)
- Prevent duplicate subscription ID's in destinationCache of DefaultSubscriptionRegistry [#32625](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32625)
- When retrieval of a LoadTimeWeaverAware bean fails the resulting exception message may not indicate why it was being created [#32470](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32470)

## :lady_beetle: Bug Fixes

- Do not send Cookie header in reactive JdkClientHttpRequest if no cookies added [#32799](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/32799)
- Inconsistent use of cleaned URLs in PathMatchingResourcePatternResolver [#32828](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32828)
- DeferredQueryInvocationHandler fails to unwrap QuerySqmImpl class outside of transaction [#32766](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32766)
- BindingReflectionHintsRegistrar#registerReflectionHints can be invoked with a null type [#32753](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32753)
- `AnnotationConfigWebApplicationContext` should propagate `ApplicationStartup` to `BeanFactory` [#32747](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32747)
- Ignore non-String keys in `PropertiesPropertySource.getPropertyNames()` [#32742](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32742)
- `MergedAnnotations` search does not find container for repeatable annotation [#32731](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32731)
- "multiple subscribers not supported" when using WebClient exchange [#32727](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32727)
- ConfigurationClassEnhancer should consistently trigger FastClass creation at build-time [#32682](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32682)
- HttpComponentsClientHttpRequestFactory does not set Content-Length: 0 [#32678](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32678)
- Wrong proxy generation order during AOT for classes with `ScopedProxyMode.TARGET\_CLASS` and advisors [#32669](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32669)
- Unhandled JMS listener exceptions are not propagated [#32666](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32666)
- beanFactory#getBean with arguments ignore them if an Instance supplier is defined [#32657](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32657)
- Incorrect AsyncRequestTimeoutException handling in ResponseEntityExceptionHandler [#32644](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32644)
- Include actual cause's message in various parsing exception messages [#32636](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/32636)
- Configuration class with Bean factory method on an interface generates wrong target with AOT [#32609](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32609)
- RestClient observations are stopped before ResponseSpec calls [#32575](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32575)
- MvcUriComponentsBuilder.fromMethodName does not pick the annotated method transparently [#32553](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32553)
- Deadlock/Stall in ConcurrentWebSocketSessionDecorator with Undertow 2.3.10 [#32445](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32445)
- RSocket setup payload can cause Netty ByteBuf leak [#32424](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32424)
- WebFlux temporary file not always deleted with parallel uploads. [#31217](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31217)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Replace RFC 7807 by RFC 9457 in documentation [#32806](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32806)
- Links to Framework and Servlet Javadoc from Framework's Kotlin API documentation are broken [#32797](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32797)
- Fix incorrect class reference syntax in Kotlin code sample [#32733](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/32733)
- Improve documentation advising against use of HandlerInterceptor for security [#32729](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32729)
- Inconsistent behaviour on transactional async method [#32709](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32709)
- Document that getBean with arguments is not recommended with AOT [#32690](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32690)
- Provide an example of custom request URL with RestClient in the reference guide [#32685](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32685)
- Correct documentation on streaming with MockMvcWebTestClient [#32687](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32687)
- Document limitations of CGLIB proxy class generation in JPMS module setups [#32671](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32671)
- Update links to HttpOnly documentation at OWASP in `ResponseCookie` [#32663](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/32663)
- Document that RestTemplate may not return a body for certain exceptions [#32641](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32641)
- Document that DataIntegrityViolationException can also be thrown on read-only queries [#32631](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32631)
- Update documentation to explain streaming vs collecting and error handling with `Flux<T>` return values [#32630](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32630)
- Revise "The IoC Container" section to be more relevant for modern Spring applications [#32429](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32429)
- XML bean definition with `factory-method` does not always determine correct target type [#32091](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32091)
- Document `@Order` behavior on types, bean methods, and config classes [#30177](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30177)
- Clarify recommendation on self-injection for legitimate use cases (e.g. `@Transactional` re-entrant calls) [#28299](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28299)

## :hammer: Dependency Upgrades

- Upgrade to Micrometer 1.12.6 [#32810](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32810)
- Upgrade to Reactor 2023.0.6 [#32786](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32786)

github.com/repos/spring-projects/spring-framework/tarball/v6.2.0-M1","zipball_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/spring-projects/spring-framework/zipball/v6.2.0-M1","body":"## :star: New Features

- Remove unnecessary `method.isAccessible()` invocation [#32548](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32548)
- Improve names of classes generated by the SpEL compiler [#32497](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32497)
- Refine null-safety with NullAway build-time checks [#32475](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32475)
- Consistent handling of undeclared checked exceptions in CGLIB proxies [#32469](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/32469)
- Resolve property-dependent parameter names for exception messages [#32462](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/32462)
- Consistent ErrorHandler support in TaskScheduler variants [#32460](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32460)
- Add CBOR support to `AllEncompassingFormHttpMessageConverter` [#32428](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32428)
- Reject `null` return value from `MethodReplacer` for primitive return type [#32412](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/32412)
- Make SpEL's `OptimalPropertyAccessor` private [#32410](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32410)
- NPE when using `pathExtension` predicate for routes that have no file extensions [#32404](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32404)
- Use `Map#computeIfAbsent` in SpEL support classes [#32385](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32385)
- Use `ELContext` instead of deprecated `VariableResolver` API in `JspPropertyAccessor` [#32383](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32383)
- Add web support for YAML via Jackson [#32345](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/32345)
- Add DataSource configuration/exposure to LocalEntityManagerFactoryBean [#32344](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32344)
- `ServletResponseHttpHeaders` ignores content type in `ServletResponse` [#32339](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32339)
- Use `ConcurrentHashMap.newKeySet` where feasible [#32294](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/32294)
- Avoid resizing of fixed-size `HashSet`/`LinkedHashSet` variants [#32291](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/32291)
- Support backticks for quoted identifiers in `spring-r2dbc` [#32285](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32285)
- Avoid internal lifecycle synchronization for `SingleConnectionFactory` and `SingleConnectionDataSource` [#32284](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32284)
- DefaultMessageListenerContainer should be able to scale down using default config [#32260](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32260)
- Revise DefaultMessageListenerContainer for first-class virtual thread support [#32252](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32252)
- Optimize Request Predicate attribute merging [#32245](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32245)
- Add ThreadLocalAccessor for LocaleContext and RequestAttributes [#32243](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/32243)
- Avoid ASYNC dispatch if possible in DefaultAsyncServerResponse  [#32223](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32223)
- Deprecate LobHandler and SqlXmlHandler abstractions (including SqlLobValue and related support classes) [#32179](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32179)
- Revisit default lifecycle phases and timeouts (e.g. for ThreadPoolTaskScheduler) [#32152](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32152)
- Harmonize ChannelRegistration to use Executor rather than TaskExecutor [#32129](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32129)
- Deprecate HttpHeaders.writableHttpHeaders [#32116](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32116)
- JsonPathAssertions methods that take a type used as a lambda should be ordered consistently [#32062](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32062)
- Deprecate local variable support in SpEL's internal `ExpressionState` [#32004](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32004)
- Support sending large STOMP messages as fragmented frames on `WebSocketStompClient` [#31970](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/31970)
- NamedParameterJdbcTemplate does not support backticks for quoted identifiers [#31944](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31944)
- Use UTF-8 by default for JSON multipart content in `ContentRequestMatchers` [#31924](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/31924)
- Add interception of RFC-7807 responses [#31822](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/31822)
- Provide more control over charset parameter when writing form data [#31781](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/31781)
- Enhance WebTestClient to support JSONPath decoding to higher level objects [#31653](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31653)
- Enhance JsonPathExpectationsHelper to allow use of JSONPath Configuration [#31651](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31651)
- Support "--" end of options in SimpleCommandLineArgsParser [#31513](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/31513)
- Make use of bean definition overriding more visible [#31288](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31288)
- Initial support for Servlet 6.1 [#31159](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31159)
- Initial support for JPA 3.2 [#31157](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31157)
- Support to propagate a savepoint operation via TransactionSynchronization [#30509](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30509)
- Resolve type variable recursively in `GenericTypeResolver` [#30079](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/30079)
- Propagate WebClient attributes into underlying HTTP client request where possible [#29958](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/29958)
- Provide a safe way to override and mock beans in the TestContext framework [#29917](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29917)
- Invoke methods via public interface/superclass in compiled SpEL expressions [#29857](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29857)
- Introduce null-safe index operator in SpEL [#29847](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/29847)
- `@Valid` annotation can't establish dependency relationship between beans  [#29730](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29730)
- Optimize constructor dependency injection performance for parameter name matches [#28122](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28122)
- Efficient webjars version resolution via `webjars-locator-lite` [#27619](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27619)
- Throw Exception when two primary beans are present in one factory [#26612](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/26612)
- Allow creation of Beans that cannot be autowired by type unless qualified [#26528](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26528)
-  Introduce `IndexAccessor` SPI to customize the SpEL `Indexer` [#26478](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/26478)
- Introduce support for non-`@Primary` fallback beans [#26241](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26241)
- Optimize ConfigurationClassPostProcessor#enhanceConfigurationClasses method to shorten startup time [#25738](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25738)
- Inherited `@Transactional` methods should be able to use class-level TransactionManager qualifier from concrete class [#24291](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24291)
- TaskScheduler does not work with TaskDecorator [#23755](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23755)
- Synchronization during singleton creation may result in deadlock [#23501](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23501)
- Allow global default for `@Transactional` rollback behavior on checked exceptions [#23473](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23473)
- Add support for resolving multiple bounds in type variables [#22902](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22902)
- `@Transactional` annotation can't establish dependency relationship between beans [#22526](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22526)
- Asynchronous EntityManagerFactory bootstrapping to complete on context refresh completion [SPR-17334] [#21868](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21868)
- Provide a mechanism to be notified that a bean has been created [SPR-16822] [#21362](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21362)
- Reduce the effect of different base package configuration on component scanning performance and make the effect more intuitive [SPR-16649] [#21190](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21190)
- Support AssertJ variant in MockMvc [SPR-16637] [#21178](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21178)
- Support configuration of connection URL via EmbeddedDatabaseBuilder  [SPR-16619] [#21160](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21160)
- Revisit storage of null attributes in AbstractFallbackTransaction/CacheAttributeSource [SPR-15513] [#20072](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/20072)
- Asynchronous initialization of beans during startup [SPR-14920] [#19487](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/19487)
- Autowiring with `@Autowired`/`@Inject` get much slower than with `@Resource` as the number of classes increases [SPR-13086] [#17677](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17677)
- Parallel bean initialization during startup [SPR-8767] [#13410](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/13410)
- Support escaping prefix and separator in property placeholders [SPR-4953] [#9628](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/9628)

## :lady_beetle: Bug Fixes

- Transactional event listener invoked like standard event listener if `@EnableTransactionManagement` not active [#32319](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32319)
- Stop overriding thread name prefix for externally configured Executor in ChannelRegistration [#32132](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32132)
- WebClient and RestClient's defaultRequest(..) is not invoked early enough [#32053](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32053)
- Alias resolution in `SimpleAliasRegistry` depends on hash codes of alias values [#32024](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32024)
- Fix `DefaultDataBuffer#getNativeBuffer()` to set correct limit [#32009](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/32009)
- DefaultDataBuffer#setNativeBuffer violates contract of DataBuffer [#30984](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30984)
- The method getNativeBuffer() in DefaultDataBuffer returns misconfigured ByteBuffer [#30967](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30967)
- ApplicationContext caches are not cleared as expected when beans are lazy initialized [#30954](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30954)
- A configuration class superclass that is skipped due to register bean phase conditions is ignored when another configuration class that extends it is processed [#28676](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28676)
- Configuration class parsing registers bean in parent class if overridden `@Bean` method defines an alternative name [#28286](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28286)
- Conditions to determine if `@ComponentScan` should be applied can be chosen from the wrong class [#27077](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27077)
- Fallback with placeholder is evaluated even if the fallback is not required [#26268](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26268)
- Name of scanned `@Configuration` class affects `@Import` to work or fail [#24643](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24643)
- Reject conditional `@ComponentScan` declarations that rely on the REGISTER\_BEAN phase [#23206](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23206)
- Initialization blocked by multi-threaded event publishing [SPR-16357] [#20904](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/20904)
- Invalid instance injected for generic type in case of partial type variable [SPR-16179] [#20727](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/20727)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Polish Bean Overriding in Tests section of the reference guide [#32411](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/32411)
- Improve Javadoc for `substituteNamedParameters()` in `NamedParameterUtils` regarding empty lists [#32380](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/32380)
- `StringUtils.uriDecode` decodes strings with non-ASCII characters incorrectly [#32360](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32360)
- Improve documentation for SpEL indexing support [#32355](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32355)
- Document when the JPA infrastructure is ready for use [#26153](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26153)
- Refactor configuration code samples to be more relevant for modern Spring applications [#22171](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22171)

- Upgrade to HtmlUnit 3.11.0 [#30392](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30392)
- Upgrade to Micrometer 1.13.0-RC1 [#32595](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32595)
- Upgrade to Reactor 2024.0.0-M1 [#32591](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32591)

- Maximum Request Size handling support for Undertow in StandardMultipartHttpServletRequest [#32549](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32549)
- Introduce common support for is-null-safe checks in SpEL nodes [#32516](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32516)
- Avoid additional unnecessary `Annotation` array cloning in `TypeDescriptor` [#32476](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32476)
- Avoid cloning empty `Annotation` array in `TypeDescriptor` [#32405](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/32405)

## :lady_beetle: Bug Fixes

- Refine scheme, userinfo, host and port parsing in UriComponentsBuilder [#32616](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32616)
- "GET must not have a request body" exception with OkhttpClient and BufferingClientHttpRequestFactory [#32612](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32612)
- JMSTemplate.sendAndReceive does not propagate tracer over the wire [#32606](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32606)
- Calling Kotlin suspend functions in non-reactive application crashes due to unresolvable class [#32599](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32599)
- `MethodIntrospector.selectMethods()` fails to detect bridge methods across ApplicationContexts [#32586](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32586)
- Fix handling value class with private constructor on proxy [#32536](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/32536)
- ReactorNettyClientResponse should not dispose connection [#32528](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32528)
- `CompoundExpression` omits null-safe syntax in AST string representation of null-safe selection/projection in SpEL [#32515](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32515)
- Generic Kotlin controllers got broken in 6.1.5 [#32510](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32510)
- WebFlux Blocking controller runs on non-blocking thread when request input data present [#32502](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32502)
- Generic interface on `FactoryBean` class not autowired in case of `targetType` mismatch [#32489](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32489)
- `HeaderContentNegotiationStrategy.resolveMediaTypes()` throws unexpected `InvalidMimeTypeException` [#32483](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32483)
- JmsUtils.commitIfNecessary catches and ignores JMS IllegalStateException, losing message with ActiveMQ Artemis [#32473](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32473)
- Missing bean class in native image with a Kotlin nested class [#32472](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32472)
- Spring MVC re-creates form data from request params and re-encoding can change the content-length [#32471](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32471)
- Unhandled JMS exceptions are not always recorded as observation errors [#32458](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32458)
- Consistently apply TaskDecorator to ManagedExecutorService as well [#32455](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32455)

- Default strategy for ProblemDetail error codes wrongly document how "detail" is supported [#32446](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/32446)

- Add query parameters to MockMvc Kotlin DSL [#32371](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/32371)
- Optimize content type parsing in `ServletServerHttpResponse` [#32361](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32361)
- Refine handling of disconnected client error in ExceptionHandlerExceptionResolver [#32359](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32359)
- Refine `\*HttpMessageConverter#getContentLength` return value null safety [#32325](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32325)
- Optimize HttpHeaders.getAcceptLanguageAsLocales [#32318](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/32318)
- SimpleAsyncTaskScheduler: consistently apply default error handling [#32298](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32298)

- WebClient request sent twice instantly when using `@Cacheable` [#32370](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32370)
- AopUtils.getMostSpecificMethod does not return original method for proxy-derived method anymore [#32365](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32365)

- Compiled SpEL expression fails if `#root` or `#this` is a non-public type [#32356](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32356)
- Suspend handler methods fail on nullable `value class` parameters [#32353](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32353)
- Better protect against concurrent error handling for async requests [#32340](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32340)
- Performance degradation due to Kotlin value class checks [#32334](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32334)
- With value referenced from property file in XML configuration, setter selection can be random in case of overloaded setter methods (e.g. on SimpleClientHttpRequestFactory) [#32329](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32329)
- `constructor-impl` of Kotlin `value class` is not called [#32324](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32324)
- ContentCachingResponseWrapper no longer honors Content-Type and Content-Length [#32317](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32317)
- Hibernate native image support broken by `HHH-17643` [#32311](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32311)
- Revisit DatabaseMetadata#getProcedures to only apply fallback if original search yield more than one result [#32295](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32295)
- Remove Observation.Context from WebClient request [#32198](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32198)

:star: New Features

- Add missing RequestPredicate variants in coRouter [#32256](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32256)
- Adapt ConcurrencyThrottleSupport to use ReentrantLock for better virtual thread support [#32251](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32251)
- Create optimized versions of request predicates [#32244](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32244)
- Include function name in `SpelMessage.INCORRECT\_NUMBER\_OF\_ARGUMENTS\_TO\_FUNCTION` [#32239](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32239)
- Add Coroutines support to `NonReactiveHandlerMethodPredicate` [#32227](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32227)
- RouterFunctionMapping does not implement MatchableHandlerMapping [#32221](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32221)
- Initialize (another) Map with correct size in RequestPredicates [#32215](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/32215)
- Make SmartLifecycle `phase` value configurable in STOMP message handling components [#32205](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32205)
- Initialize Map with correct size in RequestPredicates [#32201](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/32201)
- Let `BeanPropertyRowMapper` subclasses customize mapped names [#32199](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32199)
- Improve client and server handling of STOMP heartbeat failures  [#32195](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32195)
- Optimize Map methods in ServletAttributesMap [#32189](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/32189)
- Support binary streams with `JdbcClient` [#32161](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32161)
- Annotate core functional SPIs in SpEL with `@FunctionalInterface` [#32135](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32135)
- Cannot use `SimpleJdbcInsert` with catalog name [#32124](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32124)
- Refactor ReloadableResourceBundleMessageSource [#32118](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/32118)
- Reuse `MapPropertySource` for `DynamicValuesPropertySource` implementation (as a template for custom variants) [#32110](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32110)
- Improve Spring AOP performance for methods without specific advice [#32104](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32104)
- Make it possible to configure any TaskExecutor through ChannelRegistration [#32081](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32081)
- Add support for JSON streams to Kotlin Serialization [#32074](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/32074)
- Avoid reflecting to obtain `validationGroups`  every time the call is made [#32068](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32068)
- Reject `@RequestMapping` and `@HttpExchange` declarations on the same element [#32065](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32065)
- Missing toString for ExponentialBackOff [#32061](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32061)
- Reject multiple `@HttpExchange` declarations on the same element [#32049](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32049)
- ClientAbortException from StreamingResponseBody can cause infinite loop of dispatches [#32042](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32042)
- Log warning if multiple `@PostMapping`, `@GetMapping`, etc. annotations are declared [#31962](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31962)
- Using types in `@SessionAttributes` is sometimes not reflected in the model [#30463](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30463)
- Improve read publisher cancel handling to avoid connections in CLOSE\_WAIT state with WebSocket on Tomcat  [#30393](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30393)
- Provide more control over JPA entities scanning [#27892](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27892)
- Provide and document a way to handle single-page application redirects [#27257](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27257)
- MockMvcClientHttpRequestFactory swallows ServletResponse.errorMessage [#26720](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26720)

- Introduce `processInjection()` in `CommonAnnotationBeanPostProcessor` [#31956](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31956)
- Make maximum length of SpEL expressions in an `ApplicationContext` configurable [#31952](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31952)
- `JdkClientHttpRequest` may block indefinitely [#31911](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31911)
- Allow `Propagation.NOT\_SUPPORTED` with `@TransactionalEventListener` [#31907](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31907)
- Review HibernateJpaVendorAdapter to align dialect to use for recent Hibernate versions [#31896](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31896)
- Improve method validation support for containers with constraints on container elements  [#31887](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31887)
- Method validation is not triggered when constraints are applied to the elements of a List [#31870](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31870)
- Use standard String comparison in ExtendedBeanInfo.PropertyDescriptorComparator [#31866](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31866)
- Detect Jetty 12 "max length exceeded" message for `MaxUploadSizeExceededException` [#31850](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31850)
- Ensure that Observation is stopped and Scope is closed in doReceiveAndExecute() [#31798](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/31798)
- Support the use of `@Resource` in test classes in AOT mode [#31733](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31733)
- Add support for configuring sslContext in StandardWebSocketClient [#30680](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30680)
- Refine allocations for improved memory profile when creating a large amount of proxy instances [#30499](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30499)
- Check ResponseStatusException reason as MessageSource code for ProblemDetail [#30300](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/30300)
- `SpringValidatorAdapter` fails in `getRejectedValue` if `ValueExtractor` used in property path to unwrap a container type [#29043](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29043)
- Add CORS support for Private Network Access [#28546](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28546)
- Introduce NoOpTaskScheduler for disabling `@Scheduled` tasks in test setups [#28073](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28073)
- MvcUriComponentsBuilder should resolve property placeholders in request mapping paths [#26795](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26795)
- Allow SockJsUrlInfo to be overridden in SockJsClient [#25888](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25888)
- Extending abstract class does not expose parameter annotations [#25788](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25788)
- DatabasePopulatorConfigUtils should only set a populator if matching scripts are defined [#23405](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23405)
- `@annotation` pointcut is not matched with complex hierarchy and generics against classes compiled by Eclipse [SPR-17310] [#21843](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21843)
- Allow registration of application event listeners in a functional way [SPR-16872] [#21411](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21411)
