:star: New Features

- Optimize ContentCachingRequestWrapper allocation for known request size [#31834](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31834)
- Inherit parent context in `coRouter` DSL [#31831](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31831)
- Declare `isStatic` and `releaseTarget` as default methods on `TargetSource` [#31820](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31820)
- Delegation support for JDBC 4.3 ConnectionBuilder and ShardingKeyBuilder [#31795](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31795)
- Support for a read-only DataSource in LazyConnectionDataSourceProxy [#31785](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31785)
- Add `MySQLIdentityColumnMaxValueIncrementer` [#31784](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/31784)
- Introduce overloaded `MockPart` constructor that accepts the `Content-Type` [#31757](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/31757)
- Introduce `toString(Charset)` in `FastByteArrayOutputStream` [#31737](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/31737)
- Avoid byte array copy in getContentAsString [#31731](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/31731)
- Improve "active" metrics handling in WebClient observations [#31702](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31702)
- Make ResourceArrayPropertyEditor supports comma delimited location patterns [#31700](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/31700)
- Consistently log exceptions from `TestExecutionListener`s at `WARN` level [#31688](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31688)
- Document need for `-parameters` flag in exception messages [#31675](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31675)
- Improve `@RegisterReflectionForBinding` for enums [#31570](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31570)
- Support direct shard database operation routing in Spring JDBC [#31506](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/31506)
- Log test aborted/skipped exceptions at INFO level in the TestContext framework [#31479](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31479)
- Avoid double proxying for `@Resource` `@Lazy` fallback autowiring [#31447](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31447)
- Add support for tuning the code generation for bean property values [#31427](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31427)
- Avoid race condition in ConcurrentReferenceHashMap [#31008](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31008)
- Allow functional bean registration to set bean order (equivalent to `@Order`) [#30849](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30849)
- Allow AOT generated classes to be excluded from code analyzer tools [#30824](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30824)
- Error page does not utilize forwarded prefix [#30828](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30828)
- Fix `SimpleJdbcCall` named parameter binding for Sybase ASE [#30231](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/30231)
- DefaultWebClient ignores baseUrl when setting URI\_TEMPLATE\_ATTRIBUTE [#30027](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30027)
- Avoid eager checkDefaultConnectionProperties call in LazyConnectionDataSourceProxy [#29931](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29931)
- Allow TransactionAwareDataSourceProxy to eagerly fetch the connection [#29423](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/29423)
- Extract common value generator out of BeanDefinitionPropertyValueCodeGenerator [#28999](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28999)
- PostgresCallMetaDataProvider should detect current schema as indicated by the JDBC Connection [#28723](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28723)
- Implement setMaxTextMessageSize and setMaxBinaryMessageSize in JettyWebSocketSession [#28325](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28325)
- Optimize cache used in AutowiredAnnotationBeanPostProcessor [#28293](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28293)
- `@Async` aspect should clear cached executors when different BeanFactory set [#28201](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/28201)
- Component scanning should be able to ignore encrypted classes with invalid class version [#27691](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27691)
- Property to control URL decoding in `ServletCookieValueMethodArgumentResolver` [#26989](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26989)
- Support `Predicate`- based mappedHandler config in `AbstractHandlerExceptionResolver` [#26772](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26772)
- `SimpleJdbcCall` with `namedBinding=true` for MS SQL Server [#26072](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26072)
- Improve default `setNull` performance on PostgreSQL and MS SQL Server (e.g. for `NamedParameterJdbcTemplate` batch updates) [#25679](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25679)

## :lady_beetle: Bug Fixes

- `<replaced-method />` unnecessarily requires explicit `arg-type` since 6.0 [#31826](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31826)
- Avoid nested constructor data binding if there are no request parameters [#31821](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31821)
- Custom Init or Destroy method from an interface cannot be invoked in a native image [#31819](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31819)
- Avoid potential refresh deadlock with AbstractApplicationContext#registerShutdownHook [#31811](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31811)
- Classes proxied by CGLIB produces NPE with coroutine async job on Springboot 3.2.0 [#31809](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31809)
- Fix Comparators.nullsLow and Comporators.nullsHigh behavior [#31808](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/31808)
- `MergedAnnotations` finds duplicate annotations on method in multi-level interface hierarchy [#31803](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31803)
- Pickup coroutineContext saved by CoWebFilter in coRouter [#31793](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31793)
- Support for multiple CoWebFilters that change CoroutineContext [#31792](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31792)
- TestCompiler should not discover annotation processors on the classpath by default [#31791](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31791)
- `@Cacheable` key generator is called after invoking the cached method in case of a miss [#31789](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31789)
- Encountered `NotSerializableException` for `HttpComponentsHeadersAdapter` when serializing `HttpClientErrorException` [#31787](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31787)
- Exclude `Part` from nested constructor binding in WebFlux [#31778](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/31778)
- Fix condition for "Too many elements" in `MimeTypeUtils.sortBySpecificity()` [#31769](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/31769)
- `AnnotatedTypeMetadata`'s `getMergedRepeatableAnnotationAttributes()` method ignores `classValuesAsString` [#31768](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31768)
- SimpleAsyncTaskScheduler: task with fixed delay stops working after unhandled exception [#31749](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31749)
- Spring unable to decode aggregated JSON content [#31747](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31747)
- cannot resolve `ServerRequest::pathVariable` in nested `RequestPredicate`  again [#31732](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31732)
- `@NotNull` on JPA entity not respected in schema generation [#31726](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31726)
- `@Cacheable` throws NullPointerException when encountering cached null value for empty Mono [#31722](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31722)
- RestClient ResponseSpec.body() throws an exception instead of returning `null` if no response body is available [#31719](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31719)
- UrlResource getFilename() suddenly returns null for certain paths [#31718](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31718)
- DisconnectedClientHelper is missing "AbortedException" [#31717](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31717)
- Constructor binding fails for `Duration` argument if request parameter is not present [#31709](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31709)
- TraceId is missing in WebFlux controller handlers [#31706](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31706)
- Wrong observation status tag when a Not Found in a webflux application [#31703](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31703)
- Correct conversion from Resource[] with length 1 to Collection<Resource> [#31699](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/31699)
- `@ComponentScan` added directly and via a meta-annotation leads to multiple scanning [#31704](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31704)
- Unable to use kotlin value classes as function arguments to functions mapping web endpoints [#31698](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31698)
- `@DisabledInAotMode` does not work in native image [#31705](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31705)
- GenericTypeResolver does not resolve nested generics - causes issues with Jackson & Spring MVC [#31690](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31690)
- DefaultManagedTaskScheduler created manually now throws a NPE if the scheduled executor is not configured [#31751](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31751)
- Include Hibernate's `Query.scroll()` in `SharedEntityManagerCreator`'s `queryTerminatingMethods` set [#31682](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31682)
- TypeDescriptor does not check generics in `equals` method (for ConversionService caching) [#31672](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31672)
- DataBinder fails with "No primary or single unique constructor found for interface MultipartFile" [#31669](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31669)
- SpEL expression on a reloadable type can no longer be resolved [#31668](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31668)
- Programmatic registration of `RequestMappingInfo` leads to "IllegalArgumentException: Expected lookup path" [#31662](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31662)
- Current Observation.Context missing from WebClient request [#31609](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31609)
- Multipart messages with empty parts are not correctly parsed in WebFlux [#30953](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30953)
- Always fall back to original method if annotation pointcut used [#30534](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/30534)
- PathEditor cannot handle absolute Windows paths with forward slashes [#29881](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29881)
- `@Resource` dependency injection fails with AOT/native [#29614](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29614)
- Reactor Netty can only get the first cookie value when multiple cookies with the same name exist [#28490](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28490)
- Slow SpEL performance due to method sorting in `ReflectiveMethodResolver` [#28377](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28377)
- Cache-busting does not work when lazy-initialization is enabled [#25488](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25488)
- Fail to register MBean with bean name containing invalid character [#23608](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23608)
- Use of `DatabaseMetadata#getProcedures` (and functions) should take search string escape into account [#22725](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22725)

pi.github.com/repos/spring-projects/spring-framework/tarball/v6.1.0-RC2","zipball_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/spring-projects/spring-framework/zipball/v6.1.0-RC2","body":"## :star: New Features

- Support `ContextLoader` config in `@SpringJUnitConfig` and `@SpringJUnitWebConfig` [#31498](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31498)
- `TypeDescriptor` and `ResolvableType` cache in `GenericTypeAwarePropertyDescriptor` [#31490](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31490)
- Consistent `Class` and array matching in `ResolvableType.isAssignableFrom` [#31487](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31487)
- `BeanDefinitionRegistryPostProcessor` should declare empty default `postProcessBeanFactory` method [#31476](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31476)
- Remove support for Protobuf 2.x and protobuf-java-format [#31465](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31465)
- Refine CRaC restoration logs [#31462](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31462)
- Allow repeatable writes in StreamingHttpOutputMessage  [#31449](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31449)
- Add support for merging two BeanRegistrationAotContribution instances [#31446](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31446)
- Kotlin BeanFactory.getBean extension fails with nested generic in context [#31439](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31439)
- Log warning and skip resource hint registration for classpath location patterns [#31429](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31429)
- Revisit AOT support for generic constructor argument values [#31420](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31420)
- Add UriBuilderFactoryArgumentResolver. [#31413](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/31413)
- Add Coroutines support for `@Cacheable` [#31412](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31412)
- `PartEvent` API should support limiting the number of file parts [#31343](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31343)
- Revise support for quoted identifiers in `SimpleJdbcInsert` [#31208](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31208)
- When configuration class parsing fails, provide more information about the class that triggered the failure [#31146](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31146)
- WebClientResponseException defaults to ISO-8859-1 [#31072](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31072)
- Introduce `@DisabledInAotMode` in the TestContext framework [#30834](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30834)
- Support `TypedStringValue` during AOT processing [#29074](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29074)
- Support ETag generation on ResourceHttpRequestHandler [#29031](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29031)
- Better error reporting for `@Bean` creating when bean instance has been replaced with an incompatible type [#28897](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28897)
- Add Coroutines support for `@EventListener` [#28343](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28343)
- Support "\*" catch-all mappings for MockMvc Filter registrations [#28041](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/28041)
- Guard against `ConcurrentModificationException` when the response processes `commitActions` [#27587](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27587)
- Improve `ControlFlowPointcut` extensibility [#27187](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27187)
- Uploading a too-large file should be a 4xx client error, not a 500 Internal Server Error [#27170](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27170)
- Add special handling of disconnected client errors in ExceptionHandlerExceptionResolver [#26181](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26181)

## :lady_beetle: Bug Fixes

- ConstructorResolver rejects a candidate if the parameter value is `null` [#31495](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31495)
- 3.2.0-RC1: No primary or single unique constructor found for interface java.util.Set [#31488](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31488)
- Can't link to Spring Framework 6.1.0 release candidate documentation [#31480](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31480)
- In `MockMvc` tests all filters end up with empty-string `filterName`, breaking `OncePerRequestFilter` [#31474](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31474)
- `<mvc:annotation-driven>` should not instantiate bean property values [#31472](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31472)
- Graal VM native image: Substitution target for o.s.o.j.v.Target\_BytecodeProvider is not loaded [#31452](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31452)
- JdkClientHttpRequest does not support Content-Length 0 [#31451](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31451)
- Fix typo in `ClassUtils.forName()` [#31428](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/31428)
- AOT processing fails to determine proper target for a FactoryBean that produces an array [#31426](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31426)
- BeanDefinitionPropertyValueCodeGenerator#orderForConsistency expects values to be Comparable [#31419](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31419)
- Conversion not applied to `@RequestParam` default value if used for "null after conversion" case [#31336](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31336)
- `HandlerMethodValidationException.Visitor` incorrectly triggers `other()` method instead of `requestParam()` for `@RequestParam` validation errors [#31329](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31329)
- AbstractApplicationContext.refresh() leaves bean resources uncleaned when SmartInitializationSingleton throws a non BeansException [#28878](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28878)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Document pattern matching support in `NameMatchMethodPointcut` [#31500](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31500)
- Fix small typo in javadoc [#31455](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/31455)
- Expand explanation for the "lite" bean approach [#29957](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29957)

## :hammer: Dependency Upgrades

- Upgrade to ASM 9.6 [#31431](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31431)
- Upgrade to Kotlin 1.9.20-RC2 [#31494](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31494)

amework/tarball/v6.1.0-RC1","zipball_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/spring-projects/spring-framework/zipball/v6.1.0-RC1","body":"## :star: New Features

- Enforce REQUIRES\_NEW for correct transaction configuration on transactional event listeners [#31414](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31414)
- TestCompiler should allow to configure the Locale that renders compiler messages [#31408](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31408)
- Consistent Object result declarations for JdbcClient's `ResultQuerySpec` [#31403](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31403)
- Move `ReactorResourceFactory ` to `org.springframework.http.client` package [#31399](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31399)
- Prevent message resolution after context close [#31397](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31397)
- Handle STOMP messages to user destination in order [#31395](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31395)
- AOT bean registrations miss reflection hints on property fields [#31390](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31390)
- Support Jackson's DatatypeFeature in Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder [#31380](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/31380)
- Allow Filters to be initialized when they're added to MockMvc [#31362](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31362)
- Use schema-based config in sql-error-codes.xml [#31354](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/31354)
- Optimize uses of `onErrorResume()` [#31352](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/31352)
- AOT bean registrations miss reflection hints on interfaces [#31350](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31350)
- `SimpleAsyncTaskScheduler` should run fixed-delay tasks on scheduler thread [#31334](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31334)
- Allow custom observation convention for `RestClient` [#31325](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/31325)
- MockMvcHttpClientConnector support for RequestPostProcessor hook [#31298](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31298)
- Expose `shouldHandle(ApplicationEvent)` in `ApplicationListenerMethodAdapter` [#31295](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31295)
- Make `ReactorNettyClientRequestFactory` lifecycle-aware [#31281](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31281)
- Add a constructor with externally managed Reactor Netty resources to `ReactorNettyClientRequestFactory` [#31280](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31280)
- Consistent `CannotAcquireLockException` translation for PostgreSQL serialization failure behind JPA [#31274](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31274)
- Simplify `ServerRequestExtensions.queryParamOrNull()` [#31264](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/31264)
- Reduce nested class lookups in ClassUtils [#31258](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31258)
- Print JVM restoration time in `DefaultLifecycleProcessor` [#31252](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31252)
- ValueLoaderEntryProcessor should not be created for every call to JCacheCache#get [#31250](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31250)
- Introduce `initialize()` method in `AbstractRoutingDataSource` and `AbstractRoutingConnectionFactory` [#31248](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/31248)
- Add `MappingJackson2MessageConverter` constructors that accept an `ObjectMapper` [#31234](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/31234)
- Eliminate synchronized block to avoid thread pinning in SingletonSupplier [#31227](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/31227)
- Add OuputStream BodyInserter [#31184](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31184)
- SseEmitter should format a multiline String [#30965](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30965)
- Suppress logging from HandlerMapping when used for Spring Security's mvcRequestMatcher [#30349](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30349)
- Lenient handling of unencoded URIs in ForwardedHeaderTransformer [#30137](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/30137)
- Support DispatcherType.INCLUDE in DefaultServletHttpRequestHandler [#30113](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/30113)
- Introduce caching for functional routing [#29985](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/29985)
- Log `CglibAopProxy` errors as `WARN` instead of `INFO` [#29773](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/29773)
- Add CharBufferDecoder [#29741](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/29741)
- Provide the HttpRequest on the ClientResponse interface [#28397](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/28397)
- Batch update return generated keys [#28132](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/28132)
- Allow filters to be registered with MockMvc for particular dispatcher types [#27717](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27717)
- Introduce class-level execution phases for `@Sql` [#27285](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/27285)
- Add default methods to `MailSender` and `JavaMailSender` as appropriate [#23651](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23651)
- Remove all ApplicationListenerMethodAdapters on context close [SPR-17456] [#21988](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21988)
- Handle STOMP messages from client session in order  [#21798](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21798)
- Call `Lifecycle.stop()` for already started beans on failed refresh [SPR-15468] [#20028](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/20028)

- `JdbcClient` does not update `KeyHolder` when using positional parameters [#31297](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31297)
- AOT bean registrations miss reflection hints on public methods [#31293](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31293)
- DefaultFetchSpec should not buffer results in temporary list buffers [#31282](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/31282)
- Missing reflection hint on Publisher for bean destroy methods support [#31278](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31278)
- Missing reflection hint on Eclipse FileLocator [#31271](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31271)
- Missing resource hint for spring.properties [#31270](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31270)
- Missing reflection hints on Kotlin classes for KotlinDetector [#31269](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31269)
- Missing reflection hint on MonetaryAmount in conversion service [#31266](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31266)
- Missing reflection hints for jakarta.inject classes [#31259](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31259)
- ResponseBodyEmitter ignores calls to complete but remains open after JSON write error while sending [#30687](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30687)

- Avoid duplicate `ApplicationListener` firing (proxy vs. target) [#28322](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/28322)

- MultipartParser should respect read position [#31110](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31110)

rk/tarball/v6.1.0-M5","zipball_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/spring-projects/spring-framework/zipball/v6.1.0-M5","body":"## :star: New Features

- `JdbcClient` should reject a `List` as the parameter of the `IN` clause of an SQL statement when using positional parameters [#31215](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31215)
- Support one-time `@Scheduled` tasks [#31211](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31211)
- Deprecate `JOptCommandLinePropertySource` [#31207](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31207)
- Use `MergedAnnotations` API directly in `AnnotationBeanNameGenerator` where possible [#31203](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31203)
- Introduce `MethodInvoker` API for `TestExecutionListener`s [#31199](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31199)
- Use `Method#isDefault` to find default methods in interfaces [#31197](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/31197)
- Refine logic to release WebSocket ByteBuffer via Callback with Jetty 12 [#31182](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31182)
- Make `ReactorClientHttpConnector` lifecycle-aware [#31180](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31180)

- Consolidate HTTP Interface client support for MultipartFile and `@RequestPart` [#31164](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/31164)
- Register reflection hints for `@TestPropertySource` factory [#31160](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31160)
- Introduce TaskDecorator variant for Context Propagation [#31130](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31130)
- Introduce reverse methods in AOP MethodMatchers and ClassFilters [#26725](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/26725)
- Replace Reactive `awaitSingle()` usages by the `Mono` variant [#31127](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31127)
- Clarify and log that return value of HandlerMethod is ignored if reason of `@ResponseStatus` present [#31121](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/31121)
- Instrument RestClient for Observability [#31114](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31114)

- Refine "checkpoint on refresh" error handling  [#31096](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31096)
-  Deprecate convention-based `@Component` stereotype names in favor of `@AliasFor`  [#31093](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31093)
- Reinstate support for legacy JSR-250 `@javax.annotation.ManagedBean` and JSR-330 `@javax.inject.Named` annotations [#31090](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31090)
- Look up `@Component` stereotype names using `@AliasFor` semantics [#31089](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31089)

- Introduce var-args `params()` method in `JdbcClient`'s `StatementSpec` [#31070](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31070)

- Adapt native support for Hibernate 6.3.0 bytecode provider changes [#31051](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31051)
- Move blocking writeResource operation to boundedElastic [#30928](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/30928)
- Move blocking view resolution to boundedElastic [#30903](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/30903)
- Support parameter injection in `@BeforeTransaction`/`@AfterTransaction` methods [#30736](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30736)
- Introduce `getContentAsString()` in `ContentCachingRequestWrapper` [#30709](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/30709)
- Support configuring Jetty WebSocket server parameters [#30344](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30344)
- Optimize `InlineMap` and `InlineList`  in SpEL [#30251](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/30251)
- Update `Pointcuts` to match getter methods by also excluding `void` return type [#30068](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/30068)
- Improve attribute handling in RequestPredicates [#30028](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/30028)
- Add support for JSR-330 and Jakarta `@Inject` for autowiring test constructors [#29851](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/29851)

- Improve SpEL inline collection caching [#25921](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/25921)
- Use Comparable instead of dedicated implementations [#25478](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/25478)
- Support method injection when `@Autowired`(require=false) is used on mixed nullability args [#24773](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24773)

- Add composite for TaskDecorator [#23692](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23692)
- Spring AOP is not compatible with Kotlin Coroutines  [#22462](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22462)

- MethodValidationInterceptor support for Mono and Flux method parameters [#20781](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/20781)

l/v7.1.0-M1","zipball_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/spring-projects/spring-framework/zipball/v7.1.0-M1","body":"## :warning: Attention Required

- starting in Spring Framework 7.1, `ForwardedHeaderFilter` (Spring MVC) and `ForwardedHeaderTransformer` (WebFlux) each require a boolean argument whether to use the standard "Forwarded" header or the "X-Forwarded" alternative headers. A separate property enables use of "X-Forwarded-Prefix" if needed. The default constructor with the existing behaviour of checking both types of headers is still available but deprecated and marked for removal. The new constructor makes forwarded header processing more deterministic and aligned with what is expected from the proxy. Please, see the updated [Security Considerations](https://docs.spring.io/spring-framework/reference/7.1-SNAPSHOT/web/webmvc/filters.html#filters-forwarded-headers-security) section, as well as related changes in Spring Boot https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/issues/51030. [#37072](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/37072)
- Default context config is not detected when superclass or enclosing class is not annotated with `@ContextConfiguration` [#31456](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31456)

## :star: New Features

- Add logging operators in DefaultExchangeFunction only when debug is enabled [#37095](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/37095)
- Consistently enforce non-null instance in `AbstractFactoryBean` [#37091](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/37091)
- Reinstate invalid resource location checks [#37063](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/37063)
- Preserve original bean names as aliases with `FullyQualifiedConfigurationBeanNameGenerator` [#37038](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/37038)
- Improve forwarded header parsing [#36964](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36964)
- Avoid "NullAway.Init" suppression in favor of explicit field handling [#36961](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36961)
- Refine and better specify error handling in MultipartParser [#36947](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36947)
- Use double division to calculate applied jitter in `ExponentialBackOff` [#36943](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36943)
- Throw `ClassNotFoundException` for missing class resource in `ThrowawayClassLoader` [#36938](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36938)
- Replace `isAssignableFrom()` with `isInstance()` where feasible [#36899](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36899)
- Simplify BUFFER\_COUNT in ConcurrentLruCache to a constant [#36872](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36872)
- Apply auto-grow collection limit to direct field binding [#36862](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36862)
- Reject duplicate MIME type parameters [#36841](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36841)
- Add `DataSize` converters to `DefaultConversionService` [#36830](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36830)
- Only update `ObservationThreadLocalAccessor` when a test has an active `ApplicationContext` [#36817](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36817)
- Deprecate setDisallowedFields in DataBinder for removal [#36816](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36816)
- Optimize ClassNameReader.getClassName via direct ASM API [#36814](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36814)
- AbortedException from client logged at ERROR level with WebFlux functional endpoint [#36811](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36811)
- Add dedicated exception for HttpStatus.PRECONDITION\_FAILED [#36807](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36807)
- Reset mocks only when a test has an active `ApplicationContext` [#36782](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36782)
- Improve MimeType parser for RFC compliance [#36729](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36729)
- Reject unsafe static resource locations in MVC and WebFlux [#36695](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36695)
- Use `String#replace` instead of `String#replaceAll` where appropriate [#36678](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36678)
- Beans created with BeanRegistrar on GenericApplicationContext do not honor allow-bean-definition-overriding setting [#36648](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36648)
- Use defensive `Date` copies for `SimpleMailMessage` `sentDate` [#36626](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36626)
- Align `StandardMethodMetadata` with ASM/ClassFile support for `getReturnTypeName()` [#36619](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36619)
- Use canonical names in error messages in annotation processing [#36607](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36607)
- Provide bean conditional registration capabilities in `BeanRegistrarDsl` [#36601](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36601)
- Align with JDK behavior by throwing `TypeNotPresentException` during annotation processing [#36593](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36593)
- Deprecate RestTemplate and related types [#36574](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36574)
- Remove deprecated `methodIdentification()` method in `CacheAspectSupport` [#36560](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36560)
- Reject unbalanced parentheses in profile expressions [#36550](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36550)
- Introduce `ResolvableType.forParameter()` factory method [#36545](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36545)
- Remove redundant `Assert.notNull()` checks in `ResolvableType` [#36544](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36544)
- Introduce support for custom parameter names in `ParameterResolutionDelegate` [#36534](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36534)
- Perform case-insensitive lookup in `HttpMethod.valueOf()` [#36518](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36518)
- Add "application/jsonl" support alongside "application/x-ndjson" for streaming [#36485](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36485)

- Provide bean conditional registration capabilities in `BeanRegistrar` [#21497](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21497)
- Support `@MockitoBean` and `@MockitoSpyBean` on test constructor parameters [#36096](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36096)

## :lady_beetle: Bug Fixes

- Ignore static get/is accessor methods in PropertyDescriptorUtils [#37081](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/37081)
- `AnnotationDescriptor.findAllLocalMergedAnnotations` fails to find interface annotations [#36975](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36975)

- Restore thread interrupt flag in `DefaultMvcResult` when catching `InterruptedException` [#36876](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36876)
- Character outside of permitted range in Content Disposition [#36805](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36805)
- Reinstate Root Servlet context as a valid location [#36753](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36753)

- Upgrade Kotlin Coroutines to 1.11 [#37076](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/37076)
- Upgrade to Hibernate ORM 7.4 [#36519](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36519)
- Upgrade to Jackson 3.1 and 2.21 [#36130](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36130)

- Upgrade to Kotlin 2.3.20 [#36484](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36484)
- Upgrade to Kotlin 2.4 [#37074](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/37074)
- Upgrade to Kotlin Serialization 1.11.0 [#36657](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36657)
- Upgrade to Micrometer 1.18.0-M1 and Tracing 1.8.0-M1 [#37108](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/37108)
- Upgrade to Reactor 2026.0.0-M1 [#37107](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/37107)

:warning: Attention Required

- In Spring Framework 7.0.9, `ForwardedHeaderFilter` (Spring MVC) and `ForwardedHeaderTransformer` (WebFlux) each provide a boolean constructor argument whether to use the standard "Forwarded" header or the "X-Forwarded" alternative headers. A separate property turns on and off use of "X-Forwarded-Prefix". While the default constructor preserves the existing behavior, we recommend to use the new constructor to explicitly specify which forwarded headers to use to make the processing more deterministic and aligned with what is expected from the proxy. Please, see the updated [Security Considerations](https://docs.spring.io/spring-framework/reference/7.0.9-SNAPSHOT/web/webmvc/filters.html#filters-forwarded-headers-security) section for details. In 7.1 with #37072 the default constructor is deprecated and marked for removal. [#37090](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/37090)
- In Spring Framework 7.0.9, `SimpleEvaluationContext` no longer supports expression compilation by default, regardless of the compiler mode configured via `SpelParserConfiguration` or the `spring.expression.compiler.mode` system property or Spring property. Applications that intentionally use `SimpleEvaluationContext` with trusted expressions and require compilation for performance reasons can opt in by calling `withCompilationSupported()` on the `SimpleEvaluationContext` builder. Care should be taken when opting in to compilation, as doing so removes the safety guards applied during interpreted evaluation. [#37035](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/37035)

:warning: Security Fixes

This maintenance release fixes a high number of CVEs. You can learn more about this in the ["Spring and Security In The Times Of AI"](https://spring.io/blog/2026/06/01/spring_and_security_in_the_times_of_ai) blog post. Here is the full list of 16 CVEs:

* [CVE-2026-41838](https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-41838) "Spring Framework Predictable Session ID in WebSocket Module"
* [CVE-2026-41839](https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-41839) "Spring Framework Escalation via Session Fixation in WebFlux"
* [CVE-2026-41840](https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-41840) "Spring Framework Denial of Service via Multipart Requests in WebFlux"
* [CVE-2026-41841](https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-41841) "Spring Framework Information Disclosure via Static Resource Cache in Spring MVC and WebFlux"
* [CVE-2026-41842](https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-41842) "Spring Framework Denial of Service via Versioned Resources in Spring MVC and WebFlux"
* [CVE-2026-41843](https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-41843) "Spring Framework Path Traversal via Versioned Static Resources in Spring MVC and WebFlux"
* [CVE-2026-41844](https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-41844) "Spring Framework Open Redirect in Spring MVC and WebFlux"
* [CVE-2026-41845](https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-41845) "Spring Framework Cross-site Scripting via JavaScriptUtils"
* [CVE-2026-41846](https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-41846) "Spring Framework Cross-site Scripting via JSP Form Tags"
* [CVE-2026-41848](https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-41848) "Spring Framework Denial of Service via AntPathMatcher"
* [CVE-2026-41850](https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-41850) "Spring Framework Algorithmic Denial of Service via SpEL Expressions"
* [CVE-2026-41851](https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-41851) "Spring Framework Denial of Service via Unbounded Cache in SpEL"
* [CVE-2026-41852](https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-41852) "Spring Framework Arbitrary Method Invocation in SpEL Expressions"
* [CVE-2026-41853](https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-41853) "Spring Framework Multipart Request Smuggling in Spring MVC and WebFlux"
* [CVE-2026-41854](https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-41854) "Spring Framework Server-Side Request Forgery via UriComponentsBuilder"
* [CVE-2026-41855](https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-41855) "Spring Framework Unsafe Deserialization via Jackson JMS Converters"

## :star: New Features

- Avoid too many character access attempts in `AntPathMatcher` [#36886](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36886)
- Track operations during SpEL expression evaluation [#36887](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36887)
- Ensure getters have non-void return types in SpEL [#36888](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36888)
- Expose `ClassLoader` from `DefaultDeserializer` [#36839](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36839)
- Refine default view name resolution [#36794](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36794)
- Refine Jackson JMS converters [#36792](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36792)
- Improve ABNF rule checks in RfcUriParser [#36788](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36788)
- Detect custom deserialized `NullValue` instances in `AbstractValueAdaptingCache` [#36728](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36728)
- Warn against unsafe static resource locations in MVC and WebFlux [#36693](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36693)
- Consistent compatibility with Woodstox as an alternative to Xerces [#36683](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36683)

## :lady_beetle: Bug Fixes

- Data is lost for joined DataBuffer in DataBufferUtils [#36874](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36874)
- CronExpression skips days on midnight DST gap [#36873](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36873)
- Concurrency issue against shared cookie field in `CookieLocaleResolver#setLocaleContext` [#36870](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36870)
- Server Sent Event does not support multi-line comments [#36867](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36867)
- Regression in 6.2.0+: `ConfigurationClassParser` incorrectly removes component-scanned bean when the same class is also registered under a different name via XML [#36849](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36849)
- Bean Background Bootstrap and Lazy Init [#36847](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36847)
- Fix JSP tag processing [#36798](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36798)
- Fix script processing capabilities [#36796](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36796)
- Parsing failure for MIME type with quoted parameter values [#36734](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36734)
- Circular dependency between supplier-created beans is silently ignored on startup [#36732](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36732)
- Non-deterministic "Body token not expected" in org.springframework.http.codec.multipart.PartGenerator [#36722](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36722)
- Regression on value class parameter handling [#36720](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36720)
- Cache collisions in CachingResourceResolver [#36718](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36718)
- Unexpected path element removal when resolving versioned resources [#36699](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36699)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Fix broken links to Selenium documentation [#36877](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36877)
- Fix applicability note on setAutoGrowCollectionLimit [#36864](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36864)
- Javadoc of nestingLevel parameter in MethodParameter constructor is inconsistent with actual implementation [#36848](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36848)

- Upgrade to Reactor 2024.0.18 [#36882](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36882)

:star: New Features

- Improve `SpringValidatorAdapter` and `MethodValidationAdapter` performance [#36621](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36621)
- Support JSON array decoding to `Flux` in `KotlinSerializationJsonDecoder` [#36597](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36597)
- Deprecate `methodIdentification()` in `CacheAspectSupport` for removal [#36575](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36575)

- LazyConnectionDataSourceProxy does not work well with Hibernate's multi-tenancy by schema strategy [#36527](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36527)
- Add registerManagedResource variant with bean key argument to MBeanExporter [#36520](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36520)
- Handle blank Accept-Language header in AcceptHeaderLocaleResolver [#36513](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36513)
- Make AbstractStreamingClientHttpRequest and AbstractBufferingClientHttpRequest public [#36501](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36501)
- MySQL Error 149 (Galera/WSREP conflict) not translated to ConcurrencyFailureException in Spring JDBC/ORM [#36499](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36499)
- Add PreFlightRequestFilter [#36482](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36482)
- Support configuration of extension context scope for `SpringExtension` via Spring or JUnit properties [#36460](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36460)
- Lower log level of "Cache miss for REQUEST dispatch" in HandlerMappingIntrospector [#36309](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36309)

## :lady_beetle: Bug Fixes

- WebDataBinder unnecessarily instantiates collections when using the "!" and "\_" prefixes [#36625](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36625)

- `MergedAnnotation` does not use `ClassLoader` for method or field [#36606](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36606)
- `@Sql` fails if `DataSource` is wrapped in a `TransactionAwareDataSourceProxy` [#36611](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36611)

- `MergedAnnotation.asMap()` fails when an attribute references a non-existent class [#36586](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36586)
- `FileSystemResource` does not strictly follow the `Resource#isReadable()` contract [#36584](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36584)

- Invalid method return type metadata for ClassFile variant on JDK 24+ [#36577](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36577)
- Fix Writer lifecycle for `AbstractJsonHttpMessageConverter.writeInternal(Object, Type, Writer)` [#36565](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36565)
- Flushing-related regression in `SseServerResponse` [#36537](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36537)
- LazyConnectionDataSourceProxy does not pass on holdability to target Connection [#36528](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36528)
- `AnnotationBeanNameGenerator` fails when an annotation references a non-existent class [#36524](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36524)
- Perserve default API version in RestClientAdapter [#36514](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36514)
- Inconsistent codings resolution in resource resolvers [#36507](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36507)
- `DefaultJmsListenerContainer` may hang in an endless loop in `doShutdown` [#36506](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36506)
- Query not hidden in DefaultClientResponse checkpoint [#36502](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36502)
- RestClient closes stream for ResponseEntity<InputStream> responses [#36492](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36492)
- IllegalStateException when using websocket handshake headers with Tomcat [#36486](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36486)
- Invalid nullness information for ParameterizedTypeReference [#36477](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36477)
- WebTestClient cannot assert null list elements [#36476](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36476)
- Handle Kotlin nullable value class param correctly in `CoroutineUtils` [#36449](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36449)
- Remove RFC 2047 encoding from Content-Disposition filename [#36328](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36328)

- Log warning when default context configuration is ignored within test class hierarchies [#36390](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36390)
- Ignore flush calls on ServletServerHttpResponse body outputstream [#36385](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36385)

## :star: New Features

- Leverage `ResourceHandlerUtils` in `ScriptTemplateView` [#36458](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36458)
- Restore `ScriptTemplateViewTests` [#36456](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36456)
- Fix log message in `ConfigurationClassBeanDefinitionReader` [#36453](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36453)
- DefaultResponseErrorHandler - setMessageConverters() not called via RestClient [#36434](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36434)
- Resolve context initializers only once in `AbstractTestContextBootstrapper` [#36430](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36430)
- Invoke `resolveContextLoader()` only once in `AbstractTestContextBootstrapper` [#36425](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36425)
- Further align synthesized annotation `toString()` with modern JDKs [#36417](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36417)
- Introduce `setDefaultCharset()` in `AbstractResourceBasedMessageSource` [#36413](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36413)
- Support for JPA 4.0 flush mode "explicit" [#36401](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36401)
- Support application-wide defaultHtmlEscape setting in WebFlux RequestContext [#36400](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36400)
- Support `Predicate<RequestPath>>` in path API version resolver [#36398](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36398)
- Avoid duplicate flushes in HttpMessageConverter implementations [#36383](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36383)
- Add support for non-flushing OutputStream to StreamUtils [#36382](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36382)
- Make it easier to get InputStream from RestClient [#36380](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36380)
- RuntimeHintsWriter should comply with reachability-metadata-schema-v1.2.0.json [#36379](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36379)
- Make it easier to create custom HttpExchangeAdapter [#36374](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36374)
- Improve ResourceHttpMessageConverter target type support [#36368](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36368)
- org.springframework.test.web.servlet.assertj.AbstractHttpServletResponseAssert#headers case sensitivity [#36349](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36349)
- Allow registering serialized lambda metadata through RuntimeHints [#36339](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36339)
- Refactor calculateHashCode in RequestMappingInfo [#36325](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36325)

## :lady_beetle: Bug Fixes

- MetadataReader misses enclosing class name for Kotlin nested classes with Java 24+ [#36451](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36451)
- Guard against invalid id/event values in Server Sent Events [#36440](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36440)
- Component scanning fails against non-loadable annotation type with enum array on Java 25 [#36432](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36432)
- Duplicate ServletServerHttpRequest headers [#36418](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36418)
- Incomplete debug message in ConfigurationClassBeanDefinitionReader [#36410](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36410)
- Inconsistent ApplicationEventMulticaster state after removing ApplicationListener implemented by FactoryBean [#36404](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36404)
- Propagate max frame length to WebSocket session [#36370](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36370)
- Graceful shutdown of SimpleAsyncTaskExecutor [#36362](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36362)
- Duplicate response headers with `ResponseEntity<Mono<T>>` (or Kotlin suspend function) controller method [#36357](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36357)
- HttpServiceProxyFactory returns LinkedHashMap instead of target type for method with generic return type [#36326](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36326)
- HttpMediaTypeException thrown when calculating compatible media types [#36300](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36300)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Document `FullyQualifiedConfigurationBeanNameGenerator` in Javadoc and reference docs [#36455](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36455)
- Document `@Fallback` alongside `Primary` in the reference manual and `@Bean` Javadoc [#36439](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36439)
- Fix links to `UriComponentsBuilder` and polish examples [#36403](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36403)
- Emphasize `@Configuration` classes over XML and Groovy in testing chapter [#36393](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36393)
- Document tips to avoid issues with ignored default context configuration in tests [#36392](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36392)
- Polish SpEL operator examples in reference docs [#36367](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36367)
- Add programmatic configuration tabs in the transactional refdoc [#36323](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36323)
- Document registration recommendations for `BeanPostProcessor` and `BeanFactoryPostProcessor` [#34964](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34964)

## :hammer: Dependency Upgrades

/v7.0.4","zipball_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/spring-projects/spring-framework/zipball/v7.0.4","body":"## :star: New Features

- Cache method annotations in `MethodParameter` and `AnnotatedMethod` [#36307](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36307)
- Consistently support `@Lazy` as a meta-annotation at arbitrary depths [#36306](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36306)
- Consistently support `@Validated` as a meta-annotation at arbitrary depths [#36305](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36305)
- Let developers disable default registrations in HttpMessageConverters [#36303](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36303)
- Log which HandlerInterceptor threw the exception [#36281](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36281)
- Improve performance of hashcode calculations for request mappings [#36279](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36279)
- Improve performance of HandlerMethod bean lookup [#36278](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36278)
- Improve performance of version mapping [#36276](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36276)
- Improve performance of single pattern request mappings [#36275](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36275)
- Improve performance of validation groups determination [#36274](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36274)
- Add `setPackagesToScan` configuration method to `LocalEntityManagerFactoryBean` [#36270](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36270)
- Remove outdated GraalVM substitution [#36257](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36257)
- Introduce `beforeRetry` callback with `RetryState` argument [#36245](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36245)
- Optimize NamedParameterUtils#buildValueArray by lazily fetching SqlParameter [#36230](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36230)
- Allow customization of the `ProxyFactory` in `HttpServiceProxyFactory` used to create HTTP service proxies [#36225](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36225)
- Consistently close streams through try-with-resources in FileCopyUtils [#36223](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36223)
- Use Java Files utilities in FileCopyUtils [#36221](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36221)
- SqlBinaryValue and SqlCharacterValue should support InputStream content with undetermined length [#36219](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36219)
- Support JtaTransactionManager and SpringBeanContainer configuration on HibernateJpaVendorAdapter [#36216](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36216)
- Add TaskCallback/Callable/Runnable wrapper for retryable tasks [#36208](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36208)
- Refine YamlProcessor to allow different empty values [#36207](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36207)
- Anticipate fixing Kotlin 2.3 compilation warning [#36203](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36203)
- Allow YAML processors to create a flattened map with nulls included [#36197](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36197)
- Use Reader.transferTo in FileCopyUtils [#36196](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36196)
- `DataBufferUtils.write()` with NettyDataBuffer on JDK 25 hangs indefinitely [#36184](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36184)
- Make SendToMethodReturnValueHandler and SubscriptionMethodReturnValueHandler customizable, to allow for pass-through of message headers [#36179](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36179)
- Introduce `RestClient.ResponseSpec#requiredBody` [#36173](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36173)
- Make scope fully configurable in BeanRegistry/BeanRegistrar [#36171](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36171)
- ConcurrencyThrottleSupport and thread interruption [#36167](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36167)
- Add overloaded sendAndReceive methods to JmsTemplate to use explicit response queue [#36162](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36162)
- WebClient (Reactor) attributes on Netty channel do not clear after connection release [#36158](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36158)
- Support HttpEntity on ContentRequestMatchers.multipartData [#36154](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36154)
- Reintroduce WebLogicJtaTransactionManager in Spring Framework 6.2.x [#36151](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36151)
- Back-off for `DefaultMessageListenerContainer` is not applied consistently in case of listener setup failure [#36143](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36143)
- Early support for JPA 4.0 EntityAgent (autowiring a shared proxy) [#36025](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36025)
- Early compatibility with JPA 4.0 and Hibernate ORM 8.0 [#35705](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35705)

## :lady_beetle: Bug Fixes

- Resolved HttpEntity Controller argument does not reflect mutated HTTP headers [#36298](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36298)
- Avoid lock congestion in ConcurrentReferenceHashMap [#36293](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36293)
- AbstractMessageConverter does not support wildcards in supported MIME types [#36285](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36285)
- Make `LocalEntityManagerFactoryBean#setDataSource` work on Hibernate as well as EclipseLink [#36271](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36271)
- `StompBrokerRelayMessageHandler` fails to restart due to test context pausing [#36266](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36266)
- Deadlock might occur when calling `System.exit` on startup (against multiple shutdown hooks) [#36260](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36260)
- Missing resource hint for `BeanRegistrar` implementing `ImportAware` [#36242](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36242)
- Inconsistent behavior with `@Retryable` on annotated interfaces [#36233](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36233)
- `Netty4HeadersAdapter.remove` returns empty list instead of `null` for non-existing key [#36226](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36226)
- Generic type in AsyncTaskExecutor.submit(Callable<T>) should be `@Nullable` [#36191](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36191)
- `EclipseLinkConnectionHandle` can fail against transaction isolation race condition [#36165](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36165)

- Fix links to JUnit User Guide [#36217](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36217)
- Corrected the definition of coroutines [#36209](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36209)

- Update documentation on trailing slash handling where type-level `@GetMapping`("/base") is combined with method level `@GetMapping`("/") [#36198](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36198)

## :star: New Features

- DisconnectedClientHelper should detect presence of RestClientException and WebClientException separately [#36141](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36141)
- Deprecate `PagedListHolder` and `PropertyComparator` for removal [#36139](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36139)
- Add DataAccessException and MessagingException to the excluded outermost exceptions in DisconnectedClientHelper [#36134](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36134)
- Support property placeholders in HTTP service registry [#36126](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36126)
- Retain original requested bean class for SpringContainedBean [#36116](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36116)
- Add task rejection support to SyncTaskExecutor's concurrency throttle [#36114](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36114)
- Precompute `PropertyDescriptor` array in `SimpleBeanInfoFactory` [#36112](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36112)
- Add option for `@ConcurrencyLimit` to throw rejection exception [#36109](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36109)
- Support HttpComponents 5.6 [#36100](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36100)
- Fix double encoding in `DefaultApiVersionInserter` [#36097](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36097)
- Optimize single-char wildcard path matching performance [#36095](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36095)
- Allow WebFlux ApiVersionResolver to return a Mono [#36084](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36084)
- Configure HttpMessageConverters as a list [#36083](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36083)
- HTTP Interface with an `@RequestBody Object` method parameter should use class of actual value [#36078](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36078)
- Consistently declare `@Nullable` on  parameter in `equals()` implementations [#36075](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36075)
- Support listener registration for `@Transactional` triggered method rollbacks [#36073](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36073)
- Introduce generalized `MethodFailureEvent` for use in `EventPublicationInterceptor` [#36072](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36072)
- Avoid duplicate flushes in StringHttpMessageConverter [#36065](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36065)
- When no API version is provided, static resources fail to load [#36059](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36059)
- When no API version is provided, `/error` requests also fail. [#36058](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36058)
- Declare `TaskCallback` return value as potentially nullable [#36057](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36057)
- Fix case-insensitive semantics for LinkedCaseInsensitiveMap entrySet [#36056](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36056)
- Update to NullAway 0.12.15 and fix new warnings [#36054](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36054)
- Provide alternative to `execute(Retryable)` which avoids `RetryException` in favor of rethrowing the last original `RuntimeException` [#36052](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36052)
- Simplify TransactionalOperator.executeAndAwait by removing Optional [#36039](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36039)
- Deprecated MockMvcClientHttpRequestFactory is required for tests with HTTP service interface proxy [#35989](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35989)
- Introduce Jackson XML codecs [#35752](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35752)
- Support listener registration for `@Retryable` triggered retry executions [#35382](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35382)

- Fix `SmartFactoryBean` type matching for `ResolvableType.NONE` [#36123](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36123)
- `AbstractMessageSendingTemplate` ignores headers in `convertAndSend()` variant [#36120](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36120)
- `JmsClient.sendAndReceive()` fails if headers are included [#36118](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36118)
- `PropertyDescriptorUtils` does not reliably resolve overloaded write methods [#36113](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36113)
- Fix context class resolution for nested types in `AbstractJacksonHttpMessageConverter` [#36111](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36111)
- `DefaultApiVersionInserter` encodes already encoded URI [#36080](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36080)
- ConverterFactory nullness mismatch with Converter [#36063](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36063)
- WiretapConnector leaks data buffers when response body not consumed [#36050](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36050)
- CompilationException should not use -1 for line or column numbers when they are unknown [#36041](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36041)
- org.springframework.core.test.tools.TestCompiler.Errors should handle case where warnings are turned into errors [#36037](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36037)
- UriComponentsBuilder loses the fragment when it consists of only a single character [#36029](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36029)
- Parameter names of the handler method are null in HandlerInterceptor::preHandle during first invocation of an endpoint [#36024](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36024)
- `PropertyDescriptorUtils` does not reliably resolve read/write methods in type hierarchies with generics [#36019](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36019)
- Illegal reflection use against Hibernate Validator 9 on module path [#36012](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36012)
