- Introduce `MultiValueMapCollector` for use with streams [#35958](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/35958)
- Avoid package cycle caused by use of UriComponentsBuilder in ServletServerHttpRequest [#35952](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35952)
- Target type in Converter interface should be `@Nullable` [#35947](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35947)
- Provide access to attempt count in `RetryListener` as well as callbacks for the initial attempt [#35940](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35940)
- DefaultHandshakeHandler should not log client faults on error level [#35930](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35930)
- Log warning when meta-annotation is ignored due to types not present in classpath [#35927](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35927)
- Revise `ApplicationContext#getId()` nullability to non-null [#35925](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35925)
- Use concurrent set behind reactive `TransactionSynchronizationManager#registerSynchronization` [#35921](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35921)
- Refine `AbstractKotlinSerializationHttpMessageConverter#canWrite` [#35920](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35920)
- Register bean dependency for `Optional` injection point as well [#35919](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35919)
- Change `canRead`/`canWrite` overrides to `Class` ones in `AbstractSmartHttpMessageConverter` [#35916](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35916)
- Do not make HttpHeaders read-only in HttpEntity [#35888](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35888)
- Add WebFlux SSE support with GSON [#35884](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35884)
- Different ReactorNettyWebSocketSession call getId()  may return the same value [#35883](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35883)
- Refine nullability of `Assert#noNullElements` [#35868](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/35868)
- Allow configuring default maxIdleTime on InMemoryWebSessionStore. [#35866](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/35866)
- Refine `BindingReflectionHintsRegistrar` with `ObjectToObjectConverter` hints [#35847](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35847)
- Add `resetCaches()` method to general CacheManager interface [#35845](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35845)
- Enhance handleTypeMismatch error message in ResponseEntityExceptionHandler [#35837](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35837)
- Add support for package-private `BeanRegistrar` in Spring AOT generated code [#35803](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35803)
- Use ExtendedServletRequestDataBinder/ExtendedWebExchangeDataBinder for functional request binding [#35800](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35800)
- Expose Collection<ModelAndView> on FragmentsRendering to facilitate Unit Tests [#35775](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35775)
- Improve i18n-support for NoResourceFoundException [#35758](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/35758)
- Cache resolved singleton beans in injected `Provider` instance [#35373](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35373)

## :lady_beetle: Bug Fixes

- `ContextConfigurationAttributes(Class)` constructor incorrectly sets `inheritLocations` to `false` [#36000](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36000)
- NullPointerException thrown from JdkClientHttpRequestFactory for null request header value [#35996](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35996)
- State inconsistency in LazyConnectionDataSourceProxy when connection settings fail [#35980](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35980)
- SubscriberInputStream#resume misuses parked thread reference [#35978](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/35978)
- Shared EntityManager returned by AbstractEntityManagerFactoryBean cannot be advised by AspectJ interceptor [#35974](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35974)
- RestClient cannot make HEAD requests when the response declares gzip Content-Encoding [#35966](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35966)
- ServerRequestObservationContext(s) miss Propagator.Getter method implementation [#35965](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35965)
- Jackson used instead of kotlinx.serialization for more complex types [#35960](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35960)
- Strong locking in `ConcurrentReferenceHashMap#computeIfAbsent` may cause context initialisation deadlock [#35944](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35944)
- BridgeMethodResolver change in 6.2.13 breaks Spring Data entity introspection [#35936](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35936)
- DefaultMessageListenerContainer does not clear Session and MessageConsumer for paused invokers [#35932](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35932)
- Tighten cacheable decision behind `@Lazy` injection point [#35917](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35917)
- AOT-generated bean definition does not consider name of `RuntimeBeanReference` using name and type [#35913](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35913)
- Accidental fallback match for Collection-type beans due to `@Bean`-level qualifier annotation [#35908](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35908)
- `SingletonSupplier` should be defensive against `singletonInstance`/`initialized` visibility mismatch [#35905](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35905)
- SortedResourcesFactoryBean does not accept non-existent resources anymore [#35895](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35895)
- Support reading unresolvable types in `AbstractJacksonHttpMessageConverter` [#35889](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35889)
- Refine Kotlin Serialization codec type checks [#35885](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35885)
- UrlHandlerFilter also removes query parameters and fragment when using HTTP redirect [#35873](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35873)
- Fix handling of `ServerSentEvent` with Jackson encoder [#35872](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35872)
- `@EnableResilientMethods` does not participate in globally enforced target class proxying [#35863](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35863)
- RestTestClient can leak HTTP connections when no body expectations are performed [#35784](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35784)
- Use provided ReactiveAdapterRegistry in BindingContext constructor [#35771](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/35771)
- PathMatchingResourcePatternResolver fails with URI in JAR manifest Class-Path entries [#35682](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35682)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Correct link to Reactive Libraries in reference docs [#35970](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/35970)
- Document that annotations are ignored if attributes reference types not present in the classpath [#35959](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35959)
- Remove JUnit 4 based meta-annotation example [#35903](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35903)
- Refer to "Spring Tools" instead of "Spring Tools for Eclipse" in reference manual [#35901](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35901)
- Document that `SpringExtension` requires JUnit Jupiter 6.0 or higher [#35900](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35900)
- Fix broken Javadoc links to methods [#35899](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/35899)
- Clarify JMS `sessionTransacted` flag for local versus global transaction [#35897](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35897)
- Reference docs should not use obsolete "junit5" links [#35892](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35892)
- Testing chapter references nonexistent Dependency Management documentation [#35890](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35890)
- Wrong interface in WebFlux Documentation page for API Version [#35887](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35887)
- Update reference documentation to use Jackson 3 [#35886](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35886)

- Upgrade to json-path 2.10.0 [#35924](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/35924)
- Upgrade to Micrometer 1.16.1 [#35984](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35984)
- Upgrade to Reactor 2025.0.1 [#35985](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35985)

## :star: New Features

- Make SessionHolder publicly accessible for external resource management [#35799](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35799)

- Rename `maxAttempts` to `maxRetries` in `@Retryable` and `RetryPolicy` [#35772](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35772)
- Prevent Kotlin Serialization side effects [#35761](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35761)
- Add default API version to the list of supported versions [#35755](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35755)
- Improve user check in TransportHandlingSockJsService [#35753](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35753)

- Match against exception causes in `@Retryable` and `RetryPolicy` [#35583](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35583)
- Improve configuration of HttpMessageConverters in RestClient and RestTestClient [#35578](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35578)
- Support Bean Overrides for non-singletons [#35574](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35574)
- Introduce `findAnnotatedBeans(ListableBeanFactory)` in `ControllerAdviceBean` [#35571](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35571)
- Support explicitly specifying "no version" on a request [#35566](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35566)
- Simplify overriding of default codec for Jackson 3 vs 2 [#35562](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35562)
- Revise nullability of `TransactionCallback`, `TransactionOperations`, and `TransactionalOperator` [#35561](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35561)
- Refine `SingletonSupplier<T>` supplier-based static methods nullability [#35559](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35559)
- Add Kotlin extensions for RestTestClient [#35558](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35558)
- Deprecation warning with GraalVM 25 due to `--install-exit-handlers` [#35557](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35557)
- Introduce `MapAccessor` in SpEL and deprecate existing implementation in `spring-context` [#35537](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35537)
- Add `serialVersionUID` in `LinkedCaseInsensitiveMap` [#35535](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/35535)
- Use uppercase for classpath-related static final field names [#35525](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35525)
- Prevent empty declaration of `@ConcurrencyLimit` [#35523](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35523)
- Nullability fixes for AtomicReference [#35514](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/35514)
- Enhance toString method in SockJsFrame [#35510](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/35510)
- Invoke ConfigurationBeanNameGenerator even if a '`@Bean`(name = ..)' is provided [#35505](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35505)
- Add support for recording and reusing the outcome of classpath scanning [#35497](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35497)
- Upgrade to NullAway 0.12.10 and refine nullability [#35492](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35492)
- Introduce automatic context propagation in `CoroutinesUtils#invokeSuspendingFunction` [#35485](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35485)
- Missing Nullable on body parameter in HttpClientErrorException.create methods. [#35482](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35482)
- Introduce placeholder resolution support in `@ConcurrencyLimit` [#35470](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/35470)
- Refine `PropagationContextElement` [#35469](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35469)
- Refine `EntityManagerRuntimeHints` for Hibernate 7.1+ [#35462](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35462)
- Provide programmatic alternative to `@ConcurrencyLimit` [#35460](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35460)
- Add caching to default JMS destination resolver [#35456](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35456)
- Deprecate the org.springframework.web.servlet.view.document package [#35451](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35451)
- Support injecting the API version into a controller method [#35424](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35424)
- Provide access to raw content in RestTestClient [#35399](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35399)
- Reject effectively private handler methods on CGLIB proxied controllers [#35352](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/35352)
- Use EmbeddedValueResolver to resolve value in MvcUriComponentsBuilder [#35348](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/35348)
- Upgrade to JUnit 6 [#35124](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35124)
- Add `ParameterizedTypeReference` overload next to `BeanFactory.getBeanProvider(ResolvableType)` [#31444](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31444)
- Provide GSON-based Encoder/Decoder [#27131](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27131)

## :lady_beetle: Bug Fixes

- `ReactorResourceFactory` is not restarted properly when `ApplicationContext` is resumed by TestContext Framework [#35585](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35585)

- HttpMessageConverters overrides custom string converter [#35563](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35563)
- Reinstantiate checks for `kotlin-reflect` [#35511](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35511)

- Update references to HTTP service client in the documentation [#35522](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35522)
- Update docs to replace use of "X-API-Version" as an example [#35494](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35494)
- Document placeholder and Ant-style pattern support for `@ComponentScan` [#35491](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/35491)

- Duplicate key error is mapped to `TransientDataAccessException` by `SQLStateSQLExceptionTranslator` for `BatchUpdateException` [#35547](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35547)

## :lady_beetle: Bug Fixes

- UrlHandlerFilter breaks RequestDispatcher.forward() on Tomcat [#35509](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35509)
- AbstractMockHttpServletRequestBuilder#buildRequest is not idempotent [#35493](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/35493)
- Add support for `JvmDefault` (default in Kotlin 2.2.20+) [#35487](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35487)
- InstanceSupplierCodeGenerator fails to detect deprecated type on package private factory method [#35486](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35486)
- Fix synchronization in ResponseBodyEmitter [#35466](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35466)
- useCaches option in PathMatchingResourcePatternResolver not applied in special case [#35465](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/35465)
- Deadlock during context initialization due to EntityManager lock [#35398](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35398)

:star: New Features

- Align `JpaTransactionManager` default for `nestedTransactionAllowed` flag [#35457](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35457)

- Add DataFieldMaxValueIncrementer for SQLite [#35440](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35440)
- Consistent support for non-default NIO.2 FileSystems [#35435](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35435)
- Include exceptions for previous attempts in `RetryException` thrown for an `InterruptedException` [#35434](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35434)
- Include current exception in log message for failed retry attempt [#35433](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35433)
- Remove HttpServiceClient Annotation Support [#35431](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35431)
- Deprecate `put(MergedContextConfiguration, ApplicationContext)` in `ContextCache` [#35415](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35415)
- ServerSentEventHttpMessageReader should process empty data lines [#35412](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35412)
- Make it possible to stream "application/grpc" in Spring MVC via Flux<T> [#35401](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35401)
- Add createException method to ConvertibleClientHttpResponse in RestClient [#35391](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35391)
- Consider throwing an error if `setVersionRequired` and `setDefaultVersion` are called on `ApiVersionConfigurer` [#35387](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35387)
- Accept `maxAttempts(0)` in `RetryPolicy` builder [#35362](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35362)
- Generate consistent validation error messages in `RetryPolicy` [#35355](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35355)
- Drop support for Undertow as it is not Servlet 6.1 compatible [#35354](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35354)
- Expose retry attempts in RetryException [#35351](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35351)
- RetryException#getCause should not be nullable [#35332](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35332)
- Refine CORS logging for non-processed requests due to no CORS configuration [#35314](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35314)
- Refine Jackson 3 constructors to accept only `JsonMapper` instances for JSON [#35282](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35282)
- Revise `StartupStep` to implement `AutoCloseable` [#35277](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35277)
- Add compression support in JdkClientHttpRequestFactory [#35225](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/35225)
- Add support for Micrometer context propagation in Kotlin coroutines [#35185](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35185)
- Add support for Forwarded By HTTP header [#34683](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/34683)
- Update HttpStatus to align with RFC9110 where relevant [#32870](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32870)
- `ContextCache` should close evicted context before loading new context [#21007](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21007)

:star: New Features

- LocalDataSourceJobStore should re-initialize statically registered Quartz ConnectionProvider on context restart [#35208](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35208)
- Make rootObject parameter consistently nullable [#35206](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35206)
- Refine multipart converter registration in HttpMessageConverters [#35203](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35203)
- Introduce `getSource()` in `ApplicationContextEvent` with covariant return type [#35197](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35197)
- Introduce `ContextRestartedEvent` as a subtype of `ContextStartedEvent` [#35194](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35194)
- Align HttpMessageConverters builder with WebFlux codecs variants [#35187](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35187)
- Transaction-scoped resource binding in `TransactionSynchronizationManager` [#35182](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35182)
- Use flexible generics nullness in `RestClient.RequestHeadersSpec.ExchangeFunction` [#35180](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35180)
- Introduce `ConfigurableApplicationContext.restart()` method [#35171](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35171)
- Pause unused application contexts in the TestContext framework [#35168](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35168)
- Skip initialization of a `NullBean` [#35165](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35165)
- Short-circuit matching algorithm in `InstanceFilter` [#35161](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35161)
- Support direct matching against exceptions in `ExceptionTypeFilter` [#35160](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35160)
- `InstanceFilter` and `ExceptionTypeFilter` should set `matchIfEmpty` to `true` by default [#35158](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35158)
- Require explicit constraints in `@Contract` [#35157](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35157)
- Specify fetchSize/maxRows/queryTimeout per statement in JdbcClient [#35155](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35155)
- Include MethodParameter[] parameters in HttpRequestValues.Processor [#35148](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35148)
- Deprecate `DaoSupport` classes [#35145](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35145)
- Remove `maxDuration`/`maxElapsedTime` support from `RetryPolicy` [#35144](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35144)
- Introduce `@ConcurrencyLimit` annotation based on `ConcurrencyThrottleInterceptor` [#35133](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35133)
- Consistently implement `toString()` in `BackOff` strategies [#35120](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35120)
- Support API versioning for functional endpoints [#35113](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35113)
- Migrate `orm.hibernate5` to `orm.jpa.hibernate` package for Hibernate ORM 7.0 [#35111](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35111)
- Redesign `RetryPolicy` to directly incorporate `BackOff` [#35110](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35110)
- Ability to limit list of supported API versions to explicitly configured ones for Spring MVC [#35105](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35105)
- Refine nullability of `PropertyResolver.getProperty(key: String)` extension [#35104](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35104)
- Support for exposing additional object types in `SmartFactoryBean` [#35101](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35101)
- Add missing `@Nullable` to `MethodInvoker::setArguments` parameter [#35089](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/35089)
- Support `@RequestBody` in interface method when computing "consumes" condition [#35086](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/35086)
- Consistent validation of supported API versions [#35082](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35082)
- Resolve optional HandlerMethod parameter of `@ExceptionHandler` method to null [#35067](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35067)
- Add ability to decorate HttpExchangeAdapter through HttpServiceProxyFactory [#35059](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35059)
- Introduce `Builder` API and factory methods for `RetryPolicy` [#35058](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35058)
- Revise `RetryTemplate` for alignment with Reactor (in preparation for `@Retryable`) [#35057](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35057)
- Add ApiVersionResolver based on parameter in media type [#35050](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35050)
- Support deprecation information in API versioning [#35049](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35049)
- Add support for configuring `SslInfo` in `WebTestClient` [#35042](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35042)
- Make built-in `RetryPolicy` implementations `final` [#35040](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35040)
- Specify flexible generics nullness in spring-jdbc [#34911](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34911)
- Allow usage of `@CheckReturnValue` on types and constructors [#34910](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34910)
- Support repeatable writes in FormHttpMessageConverter#writeMultipart [#34859](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34859)
- Convert applicable methods in `Scope` to `default` methods [#34757](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/34757)
- Add public method to get bean order [#34712](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34712)
- Discard further rows once maxRows has been reached [#34709](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/34709)
- Support `DefaultWebFilterChain` allowing the current filter to provide its name explicitly [#34702](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34702)
- API Versioning Support [#34565](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34565)
- Introduce `@Retryable` AOP support (based on `core.retry` and Reactor retry functionality) [#34529](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34529)
- Revisit converters and codecs default setup in HTTP stacks  [#33894](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33894)
- `ConfigurationBeanNameGenerator` for `@Bean`-annotated methods [#33448](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33448)
- Qualified `EntityManager`/`EntityManagerFactory` injection (aligned with Jakarta Persistence 3.2) [#33414](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33414)
- Introduce JmsClient with customizable send/receive operations [#32501](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32501)
- Allow conditional handling of 404 with HTTP Interface clients [#32105](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32105)
- Allow to set TTL (and other QoS-related settings) on a per-message (and/or per-send) basis [#26840](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/26840)

l/v6.2.9","zipball_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/spring-projects/spring-framework/zipball/v6.2.9","body":"## :star: New Features

- `OncePerRequestFilter` cannot be CGLib-proxied [#35198](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35198)
- Consistently catch `InaccessibleObjectException` next to `IllegalAccessException` [#35190](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35190)
- Introduce `Date`-to-`Instant` and `Instant`-to-`Date` converters [#35175](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35175)
- Consistent nullability and exception declarations in `AbstractMessagingTemplate` hierarchy [#35159](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35159)
- Register runtime hints for `Instant`-to-`Timestamp` conversion [#35156](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35156)
- Improve handling of `ResponseEntity<?>` in Spring MVC [#35153](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35153)
- Support `@CacheConfig("myCacheName")` declarations for simplified configuration [#35152](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35152)
- Declare `messageSelector` parameters in `JmsOperations` as `@Nullable` [#35151](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/35151)
- Add getter for `OverflowStrategy` in `ConcurrentWebSocketSessionDecorator` [#35132](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/35132)
- Use preset Content-Type for streaming and reactive responses in Spring MVC [#35130](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35130)
- Leniently tolerate null `@Aspect` bean [#35074](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35074)
- `DataAccessResourceFailureException` thrown when transaction times out on PostgreSQL [#35073](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35073)
- `MethodInvokingFactoryBean` fails to invoke publicly exported methods overridden by internal classes when using JPMS [#34028](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34028)

## :lady_beetle: Bug Fixes

- Restore preference for interface (most abstract) method in `getPubliclyAccessibleMethodIfPossible` [#35189](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35189)
- Make `targetBeanName` field in AbstractBeanFactoryBasedTargetSource `protected` to avoid exceptions in logging and `toString()` [#35172](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/35172)
- Fix inconsistencies in `StaticListableBeanFactory` [#35119](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35119)
- Support StreamingHttpOutputMessage in RestClient [#35102](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/35102)
- When building `DELETE` requests, the request body is not used in `JdkClientHttpRequest.buildRequest` [#35068](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35068)
- AOT-generated bean registration file contains "too many constants" when building with many beans [#35044](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35044)
- Prevent cache pollution by storing only the factories [#34732](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/34732)
- WebFlux decodes wildcard content-types as form-data/multipart [#34660](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34660)
- AOT-generated CGLib proxies do not contain method overrides [#34642](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34642)
- 500 response for ResourceHttpRequestHandler when requested range is not satisfied [#34490](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34490)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Document how to register runtime hints for convention-based conversion [#35178](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35178)
- Link to `@ContextConfiguration` Javadoc from reference manual [#35088](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/35088)

## :hammer: Dependency Upgrades

- Upgrade to JUnit 5.13.3 [#35103](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35103)
- Upgrade to Micrometer 1.14.9 [#35202](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35202)
- Upgrade to Reactor 2024.0.8 [#35201](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35201)

rball/v7.0.0-M6","zipball_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/spring-projects/spring-framework/zipball/v7.0.0-M6","body":"## :star: New Features

- Allow `FixedBackOff` to be constructed with only a custom interval [#35028](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35028)
- Use String.replace in MetadataEncoder [#35025](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/35025)
- Revise `@Nullable` declarations for `contains*()` methods in `CollectionUtils` [#35023](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35023)
- Introduce `JacksonJsonMessageConverter.getObjectMapper()` [#34963](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34963)
- Remove `(String, String)` variants of `setProperty()` and `withProperty()` from `MockEnvironment` [#34948](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34948)
- Allow access to `env` from `SupplierContextDsl` [#34943](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34943)
- Consistently declare nullability `@Contract` for core utilities [#34934](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34934)
- Update HttpServiceGroupConfigurer API [#34926](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34926)
- Make `ProblemDetailJacksonXmlMixin` compatible with Jackson 3 [#34925](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/34925)
- Introduce hints in `RestClient` API [#34924](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34924)
- Add Kotlin body advices [#34923](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34923)
- Add support for callable references to `BeanRegistrarDsl` [#34922](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34922)
- Additional updates for API versioning in test and client support [#34919](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34919)
- Define nullability `@Contract` for `quote` and `getFilename` in `StringUtils` [#34896](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/34896)
- Support `@Import` on interfaces [#34820](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/34820)
- Use HexFormat in CharacterEditor [#34798](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/34798)
- Use HexFormat in ContentDisposition [#34797](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/34797)
- Introduce minimal retry functionality as a core framework feature [#34716](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/34716)
- Add support for "application/\*+x-protobuf" media type [#34645](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/34645)
- Support OutputStream and InputStream in HTTP Interface clients [#32358](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32358)

## :lady_beetle: Bug Fixes

- `@Contract` for `SupplierUtils.resolve(Supplier)` incorrectly declares `!null -> !null` [#34987](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34987)
- Consistent null check on injection points for pre-existing singleton beans [#34952](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34952)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Refine null-safety documentation terms [#34982](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34982)
- Stop referring to JUnit 5 in documentation [#34970](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34970)
- Fix typos in API versioning [#34961](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/34961)
- Add missing `since` attributes for `@Deprecated` declarations [#34942](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/34942)
- Improve Javadoc for `getFilename()` and `getFilenameExtension()` in `StringUtils` [#34932](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34932)
- Add documentation for HTTP service proxy registry [#34912](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34912)
- Update outdated JettyHttpHandlerAdapter example in reference documentation [#34877](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/34877)

:star: New Features

- Forward more methods to underlying InputStream in NonClosingInputStream [#34893](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/34893)
- Introduce Spring property for the default property placeholder escape character [#34865](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34865)
- Close ApplicationContext once AOT processing has completed [#34841](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34841)
- Fix `AbstractJackson2HttpMessageConverter#getObjectMappersForType` nullness [#34811](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34811)
- Add option for case-insensitive match to PatternMatchUtils [#34801](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34801)
- RestClient `@RequestBody` parameters lose generic type information when creating HTTP service beans [#34793](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34793)
- Adds option to set Principal in MockServerWebExchange [#34789](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/34789)

## :lady_beetle: Bug Fixes

- Beans created by FactoryBean are not considered as autowiring candidates if another thread holds a singletonLock [#34902](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34902)
- `PropertySourcesPlaceholderConfigurer` placeholder resolution fails in several scenarios [#34861](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34861)
- HttpComponentsClientHttpRequestFactory setConnectionRequestTimeout not working with httpclient 5.3.1 [#34851](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34851)
- Fragment.create() requires mutable map - which is unusable when used with Kotlin [#34848](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34848)
- Duplicate `BeanOverrideHandler` discovered in `@Nested` test case with superclass from different class or in interface implemented multiple times [#34844](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34844)
- Accidental ClassLoader defineClass enforcement after #34677 [#34824](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34824)
- HttpEntity.EMPTY headers should not be possible to mutate via HttpHeaders constructor [#34812](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/34812)
- AbstractFileResolvingResource.exists incorrectly reports result for resources inside of spring-boot executable jar [#34796](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34796)
- Correctly expand query param with same name from URI variables array  [#34783](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/34783)
- R2DBC `NamedParameterUtils` only expands reused collection parameter once [#34768](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34768)
- `PathMatchingResourcePatternResolver` wrongly assumes that `target/classes` always exists [#34764](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34764)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Clarify `CompositePropertySource` behavior for `EnumerablePropertySource` contract [#34886](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34886)
- Javadoc and `@Nullable` annotation for `servletContext` parameter of `ConfigurableWebEnvironment.initPropertySources` are contradictory [#34845](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34845)
- Spring MVC: `@EnableAsync` needs to be redeclared for each ApplicationContext [#34843](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34843)
- Provide a working example instead of unclear placeholders [#34828](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/34828)

:star: New Features

- Make BeanDefinitionPropertyValueCodeGeneratorDelegates public [#34761](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34761)
- Add AOT support for Registry of HTTP Interface Proxies [#34750](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34750)
- Make HttpServiceGroupConfigurer extend Ordered. [#34739](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/34739)
- Introduce `queryParamCount()` in `MockRestRequestMatchers` [#34703](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34703)
- Add method level callback for HttpRequestValues initialization [#34699](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34699)
- Refine `UriUtils#decode` and `StringUtils#uriDecode` implementation and documentation [#34673](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/34673)
- Add visibility and return type to SimpleMethodMetadata toString [#34649](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34649)
- Revise `RepeatableContainers` API to better guide developers [#34637](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34637)
- Extract `AnnotatedElementAdapter` to public type [#34628](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34628)
- Add support for `ImportAware` in `BeanRegistrar` [#34627](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34627)
- Introduce Stream variant methods for SqlQuery [#34623](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/34623)
- Generate compiled SpEL expressions using Java 17 byte code level [#34602](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34602)
- Allow adding bean name aliases in the programmatic bean registration DSL [#34599](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34599)
- Support API Versioning in Tests [#34568](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34568)
- Support API Versioning on the Client Side [#34567](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34567)
- Propagate `CoroutineContext` to the `CoExchangeFilterFunction` [#34555](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/34555)
- Introduce `OptionalToObjectConverter` [#34544](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34544)
- Create Registry for HTTP Interface Proxies with Extensible Registration DSL [#33992](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33992)
- Reconsider log level for `final` methods on CGLIB proxy classes [#33939](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33939)
- Enforce Servlet 6.1 and WebSocket 2.2 baselines [#33918](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33918)
- Consider ClassFile API for reading class metadata from bytecode [#33616](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33616)
- Give `JdbcClient` access to `ConversionService` for converting custom database object types [#33467](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33467)
- Consider not rejecting preflight requests when no CORS configuration is provided [#31839](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31839)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Turn "CDS" documentation into a "JVM AOT cache" one [#34700](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34700)

:star: New Features

- An option for SimpleAsyncTaskExecutor to throw an exception when limit is reached [#34727](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34727)
- Provide first-class support for Bean Overrides with `@ContextHierarchy` [#34723](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/34723)
- Micro performance optimizations [#34717](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/34717)
- Suppress "Unable to rollback against JDBC Connection" in case of timeout (connection closed) [#34714](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34714)
- Avoid early FactoryBean instantiation for type-based retrieval with includeNonSingletons=false and allowEagerInit=true [#34710](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34710)
- ReactiveCachingHandler still not using error handler on sync cache. [#34708](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34708)
- Add an `exchangeForRequiredValue` variant to `RestClient` [#34692](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34692)
- Recursively boxing Kotlin nested value classes in `CoroutinesUtils` [#34682](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/34682)
- ServletServerHttpRequest does not use charset parameter of application/x-www-form-urlencoded [#34675](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34675)
- LifecycleGroup concurrent start and start timeout [#34634](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34634)
- HibernateJpaDialect exception translation misses concrete exceptions wrapped in Hibernate's ExecutionException [#34633](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34633)

## :lady_beetle: Bug Fixes

- Inconsistency in `SseEmitter.onCompletion()` behavior between Spring 6.2.3 and 6.2.5 [#34762](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34762)
- Deadlock while creating Spring beans with parallel bootstrap threads on IBM Liberty [#34729](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34729)
- `PropertyBatchUpdateException`: causes of nested `PropertyAccessException`s not shown in output [#34691](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34691)
- IllegalAccessError for package-private member of AzureStorageConfiguration on WebSphere [#34684](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34684)
- Change in Jar usecache behavior with Spring 6.1.x causing java.lang.IllegalStateException: zip file closed [#34678](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34678)
- Startup performance regression due to CGLIB class load attempts in Spring 6.1.x [#34677](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34677)
- An infinite wait on a parallel context.getBean() [#34672](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34672)
- InvalidObservationException: Invalid start: Observation 'http.client.requests' has already been started [#34671](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34671)
- `@Configuration` classes can no longer be `abstract` without `@Bean` methods [#34663](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34663)
- Generated-code for LinkedHashMap is missing static keyword [#34659](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34659)

.2.3","zipball_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/spring-projects/spring-framework/zipball/v6.2.3","body":"## :star: New Features

- Add form fields to MockMvc Kotlin DSL [#34412](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/34412)
- Make ProblemDetail implement Serializable [#34409](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34409)
- Support `@MockitoSpyBean` at the type level on test classes [#34408](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34408)
- Expose order values of `TestExecutionListener` implementations as constants [#34404](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34404)
- ContentDisposition should match attributes in a case-insensitive fashion [#34383](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/34383)
- Provide access to servletPath in ServletRequestPathUtils [#34379](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34379)
- Use `ConversionService` to convert POJO to array for SpEL varargs invocations [#34371](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34371)
- Provide a more actionable CGLIB error message with native [#34370](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34370)
- Wrap disconnected client exceptions as AsyncRequestNotUsableException in Servlet container onError callback [#34363](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34363)
- Support RFC 8441 WebSocket upgrade with HTTP/2 CONNECT [#34362](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/34362)
- Optimize default property editor allocations for bean instance creation [#34361](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34361)
- Continue with pre-instantiation when current bean is in creation already [#34349](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34349)
- Allow filtering bean instances returned by ObjectProvider#stream() [#34318](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34318)
- GenericConversionService finds wrong converter for partially unresolvable generic types [#34298](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34298)
- Avoid re-creating HandlerMethod unless handler is resolved through the BeanFactory [#34277](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34277)
- UrlResource should leniently handle HTTP endpoints which do not support HEAD [#34217](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34217)
- Add API counterpart for handling Fallback and 'defaultCandidate=false' beans [#34203](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34203)
- Add support for multidimensional arrays [#34183](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/34183)
- Add getters to ServerResponseResultHandler [#34066](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/34066)
- Improve diagnostics when a Bean Override cannot be selected by type [#34006](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/34006)
- Expression performance regression due to missing annotation types on context classes [#33948](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33948)

## :lady_beetle: Bug Fixes

- PathMatchingResourcePatternResolver failing against non-jar file in classpath [#34417](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34417)
- GenericTypeResolver Since 6.2.0, generics cannot be obtained correctly in multi-layer interface inheritance (possible regression of #24963) [#34386](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34386)
- Test Bean Overrides honor fallback qualifier instead of `@Primary` semantics [#34374](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34374)
- HTTP interface client raises IllegalArgumentException if query param name contains a colon [#34364](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34364)
- Quartz-style Nth Day of Week cron expressions can overflow to other month [#34360](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34360)
- Component scan fails to find jar entries in WEB-INF/classes with embedded Tomcat [#34348](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34348)
- Check hasNext when when accessing sessionIds from UserDestinationResult [#34333](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/34333)
- Property binding to `Map` that implements `Iterable` no longer works [#34332](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34332)
- GenericTypeResolver returns EmptyType [#34328](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34328)
- Duplicate `BeanOverrideHandler` discovered in `@Nested` test class hierarchy when upgrading to Spring 6.2.2 [#34324](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34324)
- `AnnotationBeanNameGenerator` issues warning about explicitly aliased `value` attribute [#34317](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34317)
- Stop assuming that AspectJ Advice has JoinPoint as the first argument [#34316](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/34316)
- Constructor binding fails for simple types List/Map/Array and for nested container combinations [#34305](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34305)
- Change in BeanFactoryUtils.beanNamesForTypeIncludingAncestors() Behavior in Spring Framework 6.2.x causing ClassCastExceptions [#34300](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34300)
- Data binding does not filter HTTP headers for constructor binding [#34292](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34292)
- Escaped character in nested placeholder not detected properly and leads to invalid parts [#34289](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34289)
- ReflectJvmMapping.getKotlinFunction returns null for Kotlin properties [#34284](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34284)
- `ConfigurationClassEnhancer` should explicitly set custom `ClassLoader` on CGLIB `Enhancer` (aligned with `CglibAopProxy`) [#34274](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34274)
- Connection reset exception from RestTemplate call in Spring Web MVC controller is ignored [#34264](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34264)
- AsyncExecution fails to detect the return type of an annotated method from an interface with a generic [#33957](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/33957)
- Ensure Locale context is available for WebFlux method validation [#33810](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33810)

- Update RestClientException Javadoc to refer to RestClient [#34270](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34270)

://api.github.com/repos/spring-projects/spring-framework/zipball/v6.2.0","body":"## :star: New Features

- Update UndertowHttpHandlerAdapter to dispatch [#33885](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33885)
- Refine `@Contract` Javadoc to mention `this` and `new` return values [#33849](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33849)
- AOT processing for bean validation does not consider cascaded and container element constraints [#33842](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33842)
- Avoid repeated resolving of singleton beans through `@Lazy` proxy [#33841](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33841)
- Regiser runtime hints for `@TestBean` fully-qualified method names [#33836](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33836)
- Introduce support for custom reason in `@DisabledInAotMode` [#33833](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33833)
- Use optimistic locking where possible in `ResponseBodyEmitter` [#33831](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/33831)
- Revise cookies support with Apache HTTP Components in WebClient and WebTestClient [#33822](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33822)
- Remove the `pure` attribute from `@Contract` [#33820](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33820)
- Introduce `@CheckReturnValue` annotation [#33818](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33818)
- ResourceHttpRequestHandler throwing IllegalArgumentException if resource doesn't end with slash breaks some third-party libraris [#33815](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33815)
- Provide first-class virtual thread option on `ThreadPoolTaskExecutor`/`ThreadPoolTaskScheduler` [#33807](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33807)
- `HttpServiceProxyFactory` should omit optional `@RequestParam` if converted from `null` to empty string [#33794](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33794)
- Reactor Netty response should not buffer the full response [#33781](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33781)
- Relax the visibility of MockMVC DSL constructors [#33778](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/33778)
- Support Publisher to InputStream conversion [#31677](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/31677)

## :lady_beetle: Bug Fixes

- `MockReset` should be honored without `@Mockito[Spy]Bean` fields [#33829](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33829)
- Test Bean Overrides do not honor `@Primary` semantics [#33819](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33819)
- Bean Overrides cannot reliably override beans created by a `FactoryBean` with generics [#33811](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33811)
- Bean Overrides for certain `FactoryBean` use cases no longer work [#33800](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33800)
- `@MockitoBean`, `@MockitoSpyBean`, & `@TestBean` do not work with `@DirtiesContext` "before method" modes [#33783](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33783)
- Deprecate exchangeTimeout and refactor readTimeout in ReactorClientHttpRequestFactory [#33782](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33782)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Revise documentation for SpEL `PropertyAccessor` and `IndexAccessor` APIs regarding ordering [#33862](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33862)
- Document UrlHandler Servlet and reactive filters [#33784](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33784)
- Improve documentation for `SpelCompilerMode` [#33223](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33223)

## :hammer: Dependency Upgrades

- Upgrade to ASM 9.7.1 (for early Java 24 support) [#33821](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33821)
- Upgrade to Micrometer 1.14.0 [#33876](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33876)
- Upgrade to Reactor 2024.0.0 [#33878](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33878)

- Verify static resource location ends on slash [#33712](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33712)

- Rename `OverrideMetadata` for Bean Overrides [#33702](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33702)

- Polish `ServletWebRequest` [#33698](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/33698)
- Remove support for relative paths in static resource handling [#33687](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33687)
- Add `value` attribute alias to `@MockitoBean` and `@MockitoSpyBean` [#33680](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33680)
- Reject bean names with factory prefix for Bean Overrides [#33674](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33674)
- Revise handling of URI variable syntax in WhatWG URL parser [#33673](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33673)
- Introspect pre-registered singletons in `preDetermineBeanTypes` as well [#33668](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33668)
- Remove unnecessary array length check [#33655](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/33655)
- Polish `CorsConfiguration` [#33650](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/33650)
- Add URL Parser for RFC 3986 [#33639](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33639)
- Handle X-Forwarded-Prefix parsed by Reactor-Netty in ReactorServerHttpRequest [#33638](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/33638)
- RestClient should auto-detect ReactorClientHttpRequestFactory [#33635](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33635)
- Improve random source in SockJS support [#33632](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33632)
- Stop replacing existing Bean Override definitions with pseudo-definitions [#33627](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33627)
- Introduce `enforceOverride` flag in `@TestBean` and `@MockitoBean` [#33613](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33613)
- Refactor unwrapOptional method to improve readability and performance [#33612](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/33612)
- `ServerSentEvent` should implement `equals()` and `hashCode()` [#33606](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33606)
- Reduce the GC pressure due to `NoTransactionInContextException` instances [#33601](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33601)
- Make `DynamicPropertyRegistrarBeanInitializer` public [#33593](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33593)
- Improve `toString()` for `AbstractBeanDefinition` and `BeanMetadataAttribute` [#33579](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33579)
- Add utility methods for resource handler checks [#33574](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33574)
- UrlHandlerFilter should not strip the trailing slash from the contextPath URL [#33565](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33565)
- AbstractGenericHttpMessageConverter has no constructor taking a Charset [#33563](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33563)
- JdbcClient ResultQuerySpec - Provide a optionalValue() method [#33560](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33560)
- Add read timeout setter on HttpComponentsClientHttpRequestFactory [#33556](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/33556)
- Fix virtual thread pinning caused by synchronized blocks in `EclipseLinkJpaDialect` [#33546](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/33546)
- Add `RestClient.Builder#messageConverters(List)` [#33536](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33536)
- Refine null-safety for additional `Assert` methods [#33530](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33530)
- Throw runtime error for `@TransactionalEventListener` when `@Transactional` propagation level is not `REQUIRES_NEW` or `NOT_SUPPORTED` [#33470](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/33470)
- With virtual threads enabled, long-running `fixedDelay` tasks block `fixedRate` tasks [#33408](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33408)
- Provide a public mechanism for detecting if AOT processing is in progress [#33388](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33388)
- Use only one request timeout mechanism in JdkClientHttpRequest [#33090](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/33090)
- Support bean override features with AOT and native image [#32933](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32933)
- Limit reflective operations in `BeanInstanceSupplier` with Spring AOT [#32834](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32834)
- Mixin created with `IntroductionInterceptor` results in dynamic proxy instead of CGLIB proxy [#31304](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31304)

- Support JAXBElement in Jaxb2RootElementHttpMessageConverter [#33233](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/33233)
- MimeMessageHelper does not set filename on inline MimeBodyPart [#33230](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33230)
- Add handling for AsyncRequestNotUsableException to ResponseEntityExceptionHandler [#33225](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33225)
- Allow formatting of Collection values for `@RequestParam` with HTTP interface client [#33220](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/33220)
- Support rendering stream of fragments [#33194](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33194)
- Allow resolving nested placeholders if value is not `String` but `CharSequence` [#32876](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/32876)
- Support multiple style of parsing/printing Durations [#30396](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/30396)
- Restore support for Freemarker request parameters and taglibs now that it supports Jakarta [#30186](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30186)
- AOT/native support when registering beans with the Kotlin DSL [#29555](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29555)
- Offer a way for MockitoTestExecutionListener to enable strict stubbing [#33318](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33318)
- Provide access to all counters in case of BatchUpdateException with multiple batches [#23867](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23867)
- Low level cache failure for sync/reactive/future Cacheable get is not handled by CacheErrorHandler [#21590](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21590)

- Programmatic NoUniqueBeanDefinitionException in CacheAspectSupport should match message structure [#33305](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33305)
- JdbcClient.MappedQuerySpec::single can return null  [#33300](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33300)
- Registration of `DynamicPropertyRegistry` in a test context has broken native testing [#33272](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33272)
- `MapAccessor#canWrite` incorrectly returns `true` for non-`Map` target [#33265](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33265)
- BeanDefinition processed by AOT does not keep fallback flag [#33261](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33261)
- ImportSelector#getExclusionFilter does not exclude matching candidates with import selector [#27080](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27080)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Document that SpEL expressions using bean references are not compilable [#33363](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33363)
- Remove duplicated "the" in Javadoc [#33308](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/33308)
- Update documentation for fragment rendering [#33195](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33195)
- Document ControllerAdviceBean as internal usage [#32776](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32776)

## :lady_beetle: Bug Fixes

- Fix incorrect weak ETag validation [#33374](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/33374)
- Avoid CacheAspectSupport#findInCaches falling through to the reactiveCachingHandler [#33371](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33371)
- ScheduledAnnotationReactiveSupport starts the observation before it is opened [#33349](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33349)
- RestClient observation flags error for UnknownContentTypeException twice [#33347](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33347)
- RestClient instrumentation unnecessarily calls stop on a closed observation [#33346](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33346)
- `SimpleEvaluationContext` does not enforce read-only semantics [#33319](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33319)
- SpEL wraps primitive array in `Object[]` when invoking varargs method [#33317](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33317)
- SpEL no longer supports lists for varargs invocations [#33315](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33315)
- SpEL `Indexer` silently ignores failure to set property as index [#33310](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33310)
- AOT-generated code produces deprecation warnings when using a deprecated class for autowiring [#33295](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33295)
- `@Scheduled` method in test class not supported anymore [#33286](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33286)
- AOT-generated code produces deprecation warnings when referencing a nested class of a deprecated class [#33273](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33273)
- Jaxb2XmlEncoder does not support JAXBElement subtypes [#33258](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/33258)
- ShallowEtagHeaderFilter throws a NumberFormatException for responses bigger than 2Gb [#33256](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33256)
- RequestPredicates fail with UnsupportedOperationException with a custom servlet path [#33251](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33251)
- Missing observation for `@JmsListener` response messages [#33221](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33221)
- `ConversionService` cannot convert primitive array to `Object[]` [#33212](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33212)
- Spring coroutines AOP is not compatible with `@Cacheable` [#33210](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33210)
- PathMatchingResourcePatternResolver#convertClassLoaderURL drops URLStreamHandler in version 6.1.x [#33199](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33199)
-  SpEL cannot invoke varargs `MethodHandle` function with a primitive array [#33198](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33198)
- Trim last allowed origin when parsing comma-delimited string [#33181](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/33181)
- Multipart files not deleted after upload is finished with async request [#33161](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33161)
- JaxbContextContainer does not define the ClassLoader to use to retrieve the JAXBContext to use [#33158](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33158)
- Memory Leak in WebFlux application handling HTTP Multipart [#33094](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33094)
- Support invoking bridged suspending functions in `AopUtils` [#33045](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33045)

- Fix typo in the bean validation section of the reference manual [#33354](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/33354)
- Fix syntax error in `RestClient` documentation [#33350](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/33350)
- Add Kotlin example for expectAll() [#33341](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/33341)
- Javadoc of ReactorResourceFactory#setConnectionProviderSupplier wrongly states it can be ignored [#33338](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33338)
- Improve EnableCaching & CachingConfigurer Javadoc [#33288](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33288)
- Code sample has wrong reference to configurePathMatching [#33277](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/33277)
- Document that NoOpResponseErrorHandler is to be used with the RestTemplate [#33276](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33276)
- Stop referring to Oracle STRUCT and ARRAY as they are deprecated [#33248](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/33248)
- Update links in reference manual [#33245](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/33245)

v6.2.0-M5","zipball_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/spring-projects/spring-framework/zipball/v6.2.0-M5","body":"## :star: New Features

- Harmonize handling of current factory method in SimpleInstantiationStrategy [#33192](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33192)
- Unwrap `InvocationTargetException` in SpEL's `FunctionReference` [#33174](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33174)
- Support rendering multiple fragments  [#33162](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33162)
- Allow MessageHeaderAccessor to be created with existing headers [#33153](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33153)
- Generalize message conversion for HTTP message content in AssertJ support [#33148](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33148)
- Allow arbitrary packages to be scanned for Reflective usage [#33132](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33132)
- Support external methods referenced by fully-qualified name in `@TestBean` [#33125](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33125)
- Update `Content-Type` based on `encoding` in MVC `FreeMarkerView` [#33119](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33119)
- Introduce `SmartHttpMessageConverter` [#33118](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33118)
- Support property placeholders in `@Sql` script paths [#33114](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33114)
- Reject `ModelMap` argument types in WebFlux [#33109](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33109)
- Set `output_encoding` in `FreeMarkerView` implementations [#33106](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33106)
- Allow encoding to be set with a `Charset` in FreeMarker support [#33102](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33102)
- Let custom `ObjectProvider` implementations declare a single method only [#33070](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33070)
- Add support for running assertions on resolved exception in MockMvcTester [#33060](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33060)
- Add dedicated support for printing the MvcResult in MockMvcTester [#33059](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33059)
- Provide a way to determine if a context is in the process of being closed [#33058](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33058)
- MockHttpServletRequestBuilder should merge URI from the parent if necessary [#33057](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33057)
- Fail fast if a `@Bean` method declares `@Autowired` as well [#33051](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33051)
- Add dedicated async dispatch support for MockMvcTester [#33040](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33040)
- Add dedicated multipart support for MockMvcTester [#33027](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33027)
- spring-form JSP tags should escape HTML value based on response character encoding [#33023](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/33023)
- SimpleClientHttpResponse throws IOException when response body is empty and status code is >= 400 [#33020](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33020)
- `MockHttpServletResponse` defaults to ISO-8859-1 for JSON while the rest of the framework defaults to UTF-8 [#33019](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33019)
- Propagate context to message converters when streaming with Flux in Spring MVC [#32813](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32813)
- Resolve URI to baseUrl in RestClient [#32679](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32679)
- Constructor data binding support for List, Map and array arguments [#32426](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32426)
- Implement Eclipse Jetty core HTTP handler adapter [#32097](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/32097)
- Add better control over generated files registration [#31331](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/31331)
- Provide more declarative control over reflection hint registration [#29194](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29194)
- Replace `@Nonnull(when = When.MAYBE) ` by `@CheckForNull` in `@Nullable` [#27183](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/27183)
- Add JSON support to Protobuf codecs [#25457](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/25457)

## :lady_beetle: Bug Fixes

- AntPathPatternMatcher hardcoded "/" separator in variables matching and comparator [#33085](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/33085)
- AOT generates a raw type for a generic type with nested unresolved generics [#33069](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33069)
- Unwrap Kotlin inline value classes return values [#33026](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33026)
- Kotlin Serialization support does not take null-safety into account [#33016](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33016)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Move Testing below other framework concerns in the reference documentation TOC [#33083](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33083)
- Move Servlet HTTP Message Conversion to its own section [#33063](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33063)
- Document AssertJ support for MockMvc [#32454](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/32454)

## :hammer: Dependency Upgrades

- Upgrade to HtmlUnit 4.2.0 [#33081](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33081)
- Upgrade to Kotlin Coroutines 1.8.1 [#33176](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33176)
- Upgrade to Micrometer 1.14.0-M1 [#33170](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33170)
- Upgrade to Reactor 2024.0.0-M4 [#33171](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33171)
